🃏 All point cards全部穴位卡

Open a point, flip, rate yourself. The same cards also sit on each point page.展开一个穴，翻卡，自评。每个穴位页也有同一组卡。

LU1 ZhōngfǔLU1 中府

Where is LU1 Zhōngfǔ?中府（LU1）在哪里？

Upper outer chest. Find the hollow below the outer end of the collarbone (LU2), then go 1 cun down: level with the 1st intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部外上方。先找锁骨外端下方的凹陷（云门），再往下 1 寸，与第 1 肋间隙同高，距前正中线 6 寸。

How is LU1 needled?中府（LU1）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse, tip pointing laterally toward the armpit, away from the chest cavity; 0.5–0.8 cun.向外斜刺或平刺，针尖朝腋窝方向、远离胸腔；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LU1?中府（LU1）是哪类特定穴？

Front-mu point of the Lung; Crossing point of the Lung and Spleen meridians肺之募穴；手、足太阴经交会穴

Main safety point at LU1?中府（LU1）最要注意的安全问题？

The pleura and lung lie directly beneath; medial or deep insertion can cause a pneumothorax. Thin people have a thinner chest wall and a higher risk.深面就是胸膜和肺，向内或过深进针可以造成气胸；体型瘦的人胸壁更薄，风险更高。

LU2 YúnménLU2 云门

Where is LU2 Yúnmén?云门（LU2）在哪里？

In the hollow below the collarbone (infraclavicular fossa), just medial to the coracoid process of the scapula, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline.锁骨下窝的凹陷中，肩胛骨喙突内侧，距前正中线 6 寸。

How is LU2 needled?云门（LU2）怎么刺？

Oblique, tip pointing laterally toward the shoulder; 0.5–0.8 cun.向外斜刺，针尖朝肩外侧；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at LU2?云门（LU2）最要注意的安全问题？

Deep medial insertion can injure the axillary vessels and brachial plexus, or puncture the pleura and cause a pneumothorax.向内深刺可伤及腋动脉、腋静脉和臂丛，或刺破胸膜造成气胸。

LU3 TiānfǔLU3 天府

Where is LU3 Tiānfǔ?天府（LU3）在哪里？

Front-outer upper arm, on the lateral (radial) border of biceps brachii, 3 cun below the anterior axillary fold.上臂前外侧，腋前纹头下 3 寸，肱二头肌桡侧（外侧）缘。

How is LU3 needled?天府（LU3）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at LU3?天府（LU3）最要注意的安全问题？

The cephalic vein runs superficially; hitting it causes bleeding and bruising. Otherwise low risk.浅层有头静脉，刺中会出血、淤青；其余风险较低。

LU4 XiábáiLU4 侠白

Where is LU4 Xiábái?侠白（LU4）在哪里？

Front-outer upper arm, on the radial border of biceps brachii, 4 cun below the anterior axillary fold; 1 cun below LU3.上臂前外侧，腋前纹头下 4 寸，肱二头肌桡侧缘；即天府下 1 寸。

How is LU4 needled?侠白（LU4）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at LU4?侠白（LU4）最要注意的安全问题？

Low risk; avoid the superficial vein.风险较低；注意避开浅表静脉。

LU5 ChǐzéLU5 尺泽

Where is LU5 Chǐzé?尺泽（LU5）在哪里？

On the elbow crease, in the hollow on the radial (outer) side of the biceps tendon.肘横纹上，肱二头肌腱桡侧（外侧）的凹陷中。

How is LU5 needled?尺泽（LU5）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; or prick to bleed with a three-edged needle; 0.8–1.2 cun.直刺；或用三棱针点刺出血；0.8–1.2 寸。

Special-point roles of LU5?尺泽（LU5）是哪类特定穴？

He-sea point (five transport points; water)合穴（五输穴，五行属水）

Main safety point at LU5?尺泽（LU5）最要注意的安全问题？

The radial nerve runs deep. Placing the point medial to the tendon brings the needle near the brachial artery and median nerve. Bloodletting needs strict asepsis and is not done in people with a bleeding tendency or on anticoagulants.深部有桡神经；定位若偏到肌腱内侧，会接近肱动脉和正中神经。点刺出血须严格无菌，有出血倾向或服抗凝药者不做。

LU6 KǒngzuìLU6 孔最

Where is LU6 Kǒngzuì?孔最（LU6）在哪里？

Front-outer forearm, on the line from LU5 to LU9, 7 cun above the wrist crease.前臂前外侧，尺泽与太渊的连线上，腕横纹上 7 寸。

How is LU6 needled?孔最（LU6）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of LU6?孔最（LU6）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point郄穴

Main safety point at LU6?孔最（LU6）最要注意的安全问题？

Low risk; avoid the nearby radial artery branches and cephalic vein.风险较低；靠近桡动脉分支与头静脉，注意避开。

LU7 LièquēLU7 列缺

Where is LU7 Lièquē?列缺（LU7）在哪里？

Radial side of the forearm, just above the styloid process of the radius, 1.5 cun above the wrist crease, between the tendons of brachioradialis and abductor pollicis longus.前臂桡侧，桡骨茎突上方，腕横纹上 1.5 寸，肱桡肌腱与拇长展肌腱之间。

How is LU7 needled?列缺（LU7）怎么刺？

Oblique, pointing up the arm toward the elbow; 0.5–0.8 cun.向上（朝肘）斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LU7?列缺（LU7）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point; One of the eight confluent points; opens the Ren vessel; Four Command Points rhyme: "for head and neck, seek LU7"络穴；八脉交会穴之一，通任脉；四总穴歌：「头项寻列缺」

Main safety point at LU7?列缺（LU7）最要注意的安全问题？

The superficial radial nerve runs here; redirect if a shooting tingling appears. Low risk.桡神经浅支在此，出现放射样麻感就调整方向；风险较低。

LU8 JīngqúLU8 经渠

Where is LU8 Jīngqú?经渠（LU8）在哪里？

Front-outer forearm, 1 cun above the wrist crease, in the hollow between the radial styloid and the radial artery.前臂前外侧，腕横纹上 1 寸，桡骨茎突与桡动脉之间的凹陷中。

How is LU8 needled?经渠（LU8）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, keeping clear of the radial artery; 0.3–0.5 cun.避开桡动脉，直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of LU8?经渠（LU8）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river point (five transport points; metal)经穴（五输穴，五行属金）

Main safety point at LU8?经渠（LU8）最要注意的安全问题？

The radial artery is right next to it; hitting it causes bleeding and a haematoma. Locate the artery with a finger and keep clear of it. The Zhenjiu Jiayi Jing says LU8 must not be moxibusted.紧邻桡动脉，刺中会出血、血肿；进针前先用手指把动脉定位并避开。《针灸甲乙经》记载经渠不可灸。

LU9 TàiyuānLU9 太渊

Where is LU9 Tàiyuān?太渊（LU9）在哪里？

Front of the wrist, at the radial end of the wrist crease, between the radial styloid and the scaphoid, in the hollow just ulnar to the abductor pollicis longus tendon, where the radial pulse can be felt.腕前区，腕掌侧横纹的桡侧端，桡骨茎突与舟骨之间，拇长展肌腱尺侧的凹陷中，可摸到桡动脉搏动。

How is LU9 needled?太渊（LU9）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, keeping clear of the radial artery; 0.3–0.5 cun.避开桡动脉，直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of LU9?太渊（LU9）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream point (five transport points; earth); Yuan-source point of the Lung; Influential (meeting) point of the vessels输穴（五输穴，五行属土）；肺经原穴；八会穴之脉会

Main safety point at LU9?太渊（LU9）最要注意的安全问题？

The point sits on the radial pulse; hitting the artery causes bleeding and a haematoma, more so in people on anticoagulants.穴位就在桡动脉搏动处，刺中会出血、血肿；服抗凝药的人更要小心。

LU10 YújìLU10 鱼际

Where is LU10 Yújì?鱼际（LU10）在哪里？

Side of the hand, at the midpoint of the 1st metacarpal on its radial side, on the border where the paler palm skin meets the darker back-of-hand skin.手外侧，第 1 掌骨桡侧中点的赤白肉际处（手掌浅色皮肤与手背深色皮肤的交界线）。

How is LU10 needled?鱼际（LU10）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LU10?鱼际（LU10）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring point (five transport points; fire)荥穴（五输穴，五行属火）

Main safety point at LU10?鱼际（LU10）最要注意的安全问题？

Low risk but painful; do not needle through broken or infected skin.风险较低，但较痛；局部皮肤破损或感染时不针。

LU11 ShàoshāngLU11 少商

Where is LU11 Shàoshāng?少商（LU11）在哪里？

On the thumb, 0.1 cun (finger-cun) from the radial corner of the nail: where a line along the radial edge of the nail meets a line along the nail base.拇指末节桡侧，距指甲根角 0.1 寸（指寸）：沿指甲桡侧缘和指甲根各画一条线，交点处。

How is LU11 needled?少商（LU11）怎么刺？

Shallow; or prick to bleed; 0.1 cun.浅刺；或点刺出血；0.1 寸。

Special-point roles of LU11?少商（LU11）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well point (five transport points; wood)井穴（五输穴，五行属木）

Main safety point at LU11?少商（LU11）最要注意的安全问题？

Very painful at the fingertip; no bloodletting for people with a bleeding tendency, on anticoagulants, or with local infection. Unconsciousness and high fever are emergencies first: call 911.指端很痛；放血不用于有出血倾向、服抗凝药或局部感染的人。昏迷、高热首先是急症，先叫 911。

LI1 ShāngyángLI1 商阳

Where is LI1 Shāngyáng?商阳（LI1）在哪里？

On the radial side of the index-finger tip, about 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail.食指末节桡侧，距指甲根角约 0.1 寸。

How is LI1 needled?商阳（LI1）怎么刺？

Superficial insertion or prick to bleed with a three-edged needle; 0.1 cun.浅刺或三棱针点刺出血；0.1 寸。

Special-point roles of LI1?商阳（LI1）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well point (five transport points; metal)井穴（五输穴，五行属金）

Main safety point at LI1?商阳（LI1）最要注意的安全问题？

Distal tissue is thin; pricking requires asepsis. Do not prick to bleed in people with a bleeding tendency or taking anticoagulants.末梢组织薄，点刺须无菌；有出血倾向或服抗凝药者不做点刺出血。

LI2 ÈrjiānLI2 二间

Where is LI2 Èrjiān?二间（LI2）在哪里？

On the radial side of the index finger, in the hollow just distal to the metacarpophalangeal joint.食指桡侧，掌指关节前方的凹陷处。

How is LI2 needled?二间（LI2）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.2–0.3 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.2–0.3 寸。

Special-point roles of LI2?二间（LI2）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring point (five transport points; water)荥穴（五输穴，五行属水）

Main safety point at LI2?二间（LI2）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid the nail bed and visible vessels; do not needle infected or broken skin.避开甲床和明显血管；局部感染或破损皮肤不针。

LI3 SānjiānLI3 三间

Where is LI3 Sānjiān?三间（LI3）在哪里？

On the radial side of the index finger, in the hollow proximal to the second metacarpophalangeal joint.食指桡侧，第二掌指关节后方的凹陷处。

How is LI3 needled?三间（LI3）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of LI3?三间（LI3）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream point (five transport points; wood)输穴（五输穴，五行属木）

Main safety point at LI3?三间（LI3）最要注意的安全问题？

Bone is close to the surface; avoid deep insertion and visible vessels.骨面浅，避免过深刺及明显血管。

LI4 HégǔLI4 合谷

Where is LI4 Hégǔ?合谷（LI4）在哪里？

On the dorsum of the hand, between the first and second metacarpals, at the radial side of the midpoint of the second metacarpal.手背，第 1、2 掌骨之间，约平第 2 掌骨中点的桡侧。

How is LI4 needled?合谷（LI4）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique toward the second metacarpal; 0.5–1 cun.直刺或向第 2 掌骨方向斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of LI4?合谷（LI4）是哪类特定穴？

Yuan-source point; Four Command Points rhyme: face and mouth at LI4原穴；四总穴歌：「面口合谷收」

Main safety point at LI4?合谷（LI4）最要注意的安全问题？

Contraindicated in pregnancy; traditional use is associated with inducing labour. Avoid dorsal hand veins and the superficial radial nerve; withdraw and redirect if shooting tingling occurs.孕期禁针；其传统用法与引产相关。避开手背静脉和桡神经浅支，出现放射样麻感应退针调整。

LI5 YángxīLI5 阳溪

Where is LI5 Yángxī?阳溪（LI5）在哪里？

On the radial dorsum of the wrist, in the hollow between the tendons of extensor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis.腕背桡侧，拇长伸肌腱与拇短伸肌腱之间的凹陷中。

How is LI5 needled?阳溪（LI5）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LI5?阳溪（LI5）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river point (five transport points; fire)经穴（五输穴，五行属火）

Main safety point at LI5?阳溪（LI5）最要注意的安全问题？

The radial artery and superficial radial nerve are nearby; avoid a palpable arterial pulse and redirect if electric tingling occurs.桡动脉与桡神经浅支邻近；避开可触及的动脉搏动，出现电麻感应调整。

LI6 PiānlìLI6 偏历

Where is LI6 Piānlì?偏历（LI6）在哪里？

On the radial dorsal forearm, 3 cun above the dorsal wrist crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.前臂背面桡侧，阳溪与曲池连线上，腕背横纹上 3 寸。

How is LI6 needled?偏历（LI6）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LI6?偏历（LI6）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point络穴

Main safety point at LI6?偏历（LI6）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid the cephalic vein; redirect if radiating tingling occurs near the superficial radial nerve.避开头静脉；桡神经浅支附近出现放射样麻感时应调整。

LI7 WēnliūLI7 温溜

Where is LI7 Wēnliū?温溜（LI7）在哪里？

On the radial dorsal forearm, 5 cun above the dorsal wrist crease, on the line from LI5 to LI11.前臂背面桡侧，阳溪与曲池连线上，腕背横纹上 5 寸。

How is LI7 needled?温溜（LI7）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of LI7?温溜（LI7）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point郄穴

Main safety point at LI7?温溜（LI7）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid the cephalic vein; do not force a deeper insertion if a superficial nerve is stimulated.避开头静脉；表浅神经受刺激时不可强行加深。

LI8 XiàliánLI8 下廉

Where is LI8 Xiàlián?下廉（LI8）在哪里？

On the radial dorsal forearm, 4 cun below the elbow crease, on the line from LI11 to LI5.前臂背面桡侧，阳溪与曲池连线上，肘横纹下 4 寸。

How is LI8 needled?下廉（LI8）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at LI8?下廉（LI8）最要注意的安全问题？

Insert along the muscular plane and avoid visible superficial veins; withdraw and redirect if severe radiating pain occurs.沿肌间进针，避开明显浅静脉；强烈放射痛时退针调整。

LI9 ShàngliánLI9 上廉

Where is LI9 Shànglián?上廉（LI9）在哪里？

On the radial dorsal forearm, 3 cun below the elbow crease, on the line from LI11 to LI5.前臂背面桡侧，阳溪与曲池连线上，肘横纹下 3 寸。

How is LI9 needled?上廉（LI9）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at LI9?上廉（LI9）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid visible vessels; withdraw and redirect if marked radiating pain occurs.避免刺入可见血管；出现明显放射痛应退针调整。

LI10 ShǒusānlǐLI10 手三里

Where is LI10 Shǒusānlǐ?手三里（LI10）在哪里？

On the radial dorsal forearm, 2 cun below the elbow crease, on the line from LI11 to LI5.前臂背面桡侧，阳溪与曲池连线上，肘横纹下 2 寸。

How is LI10 needled?手三里（LI10）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.8–1.2 cun.直刺；0.8–1.2 寸。

Main safety point at LI10?手三里（LI10）最要注意的安全问题？

Radial nerve branches lie deep; withdraw and redirect if an electric radiating sensation occurs.深部有桡神经分支；若有电击样放射感，退针调整。

LI11 QūchíLI11 曲池

Where is LI11 Qūchí?曲池（LI11）在哪里？

At the lateral elbow, midpoint between the lateral end of the elbow crease and the lateral epicondyle of the humerus when the elbow is flexed.肘外侧，屈肘时肘横纹外侧端与肱骨外上髁连线的中点。

How is LI11 needled?曲池（LI11）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of LI11?曲池（LI11）是哪类特定穴？

He-sea point (five transport points; earth)合穴（五输穴，五行属土）

Main safety point at LI11?曲池（LI11）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins at the lateral elbow; do not force a deep insertion toward the joint cavity.避开肘外侧浅静脉；不向关节腔强行深刺。

LI12 ZhǒuliáoLI12 肘髎

Where is LI12 Zhǒuliáo?肘髎（LI12）在哪里？

On the lateral upper arm, 1 cun above LI11, in the hollow superior to the lateral epicondyle.上臂外侧，曲池上方 1 寸，肱骨外上髁上方凹陷处。

How is LI12 needled?肘髎（LI12）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–1 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at LI12?肘髎（LI12）最要注意的安全问题？

The radial nerve is nearby in the deep plane; withdraw and redirect if radiating tingling occurs.桡神经在深部附近；出现放射样麻感时退针调整。

LI13 ShǒuwǔlǐLI13 手五里

Where is LI13 Shǒuwǔlǐ?手五里（LI13）在哪里？

On the lateral upper arm, 3 cun above LI11, on the line from LI11 to LI15.上臂外侧，曲池与肩髃连线上，曲池上 3 寸。

How is LI13 needled?手五里（LI13）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, clear of the artery; 0.5–1 cun.避开动脉，直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at LI13?手五里（LI13）最要注意的安全问题？

The radial nerve and profunda brachii artery lie deep; do not needle deeply without control, and withdraw if electric tingling occurs.深部有桡神经和肱深动脉；不可盲目深刺，电麻感时退针。

LI14 BìnàoLI14 臂臑

Where is LI14 Bìnào?臂臑（LI14）在哪里？

On the lateral upper arm, 7 cun superior to LI11, just anterior to the border of the deltoid muscle.上臂外侧，曲池上 7 寸，三角肌前缘紧前方。

How is LI14 needled?臂臑（LI14）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.8–1.5 cun.直刺；0.8–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of LI14?臂臑（LI14）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Large Intestine channel and Yang Wei vessel手阳明、阳维脉交会穴

Main safety point at LI14?臂臑（LI14）最要注意的安全问题？

A deep posterior direction can approach the radial nerve; withdraw and redirect if radiating numb pain occurs.深刺方向偏后可接近桡神经；出现放射性麻痛时退针调整。

LI15 JiānyúLI15 肩髃

Where is LI15 Jiānyú?肩髃（LI15）在哪里？

On the shoulder, in the depression between the anterior end of the lateral acromial border and the greater tubercle of the humerus.肩部，肩峰外侧缘前端与肱骨大结节之间的凹陷中。

How is LI15 needled?肩髃（LI15）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique downward; 0.8–1.5 cun.直刺或向下斜刺；0.8–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of LI15?肩髃（LI15）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Large Intestine channel and Yang Qiao vessel手阳明、阳跷脉交会穴

Main safety point at LI15?肩髃（LI15）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid the acromial bone surface and the anterior long-head biceps tendon; do not needle an acutely injured, infected, or postoperative shoulder.避开肩峰骨面与前方肱二头肌长头腱；肩部急性外伤、感染或术后部位不针。

LI16 JùgǔLI16 巨骨

Where is LI16 Jùgǔ?巨骨（LI16）在哪里？

On the upper shoulder, in the hollow between the acromial end of the clavicle and the spine of the scapula.肩上部，锁骨肩峰端与肩胛冈之间的凹陷中。

How is LI16 needled?巨骨（LI16）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or slightly oblique laterally and downward; 0.5–1 cun.直刺或微向外下方斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of LI16?巨骨（LI16）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Large Intestine channel and Yang Qiao vessel手阳明、阳跷脉交会穴

Main safety point at LI16?巨骨（LI16）最要注意的安全问题？

The suprascapular nerve and vessels lie deep; angle the tip slightly laterally and downward, and never insert deeply or toward the root of the neck and chest, which risks entering the chest and causing pneumothorax.肩胛上神经血管在深部；针尖应微向外下方，不可直刺过深或朝内下方（颈根、胸腔方向）深刺，以免刺入胸腔造成气胸。

LI17 TiāndǐngLI17 天鼎

Where is LI17 Tiāndǐng?天鼎（LI17）在哪里？

On the anterolateral neck, level with the cricoid cartilage, just posterior to the border of sternocleidomastoid; directly inferior to LI18.颈前外侧，平环状软骨，胸锁乳突肌后缘紧后方；位于扶突（LI18）正下方。

How is LI17 needled?天鼎（LI17）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at LI17?天鼎（LI17）最要注意的安全问题？

The carotid sheath lies anteromedially; the cervical plexus and phrenic nerve are deeper, and deep inferior insertion can approach the lung apex and cause pneumothorax. Avoid pulsation and strictly control direction and depth.前内侧邻颈动脉鞘；深部还有颈丛与膈神经，向下过深可接近肺尖并造成气胸。避开搏动，严格控制方向和深度。

LI18 FútūLI18 扶突

Where is LI18 Fútū?扶突（LI18）在哪里？

On the anterolateral neck, level with the superior border of the thyroid cartilage, between the anterior and posterior borders of sternocleidomastoid.颈前外侧，平甲状软骨上缘，在胸锁乳突肌前缘与后缘之间。

How is LI18 needled?扶突（LI18）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at LI18?扶突（LI18）最要注意的安全问题？

The common carotid artery, internal jugular vein, and vagus nerve lie immediately deep and medial; avoid pulsation and never insert deeply medially.颈总动脉、颈内静脉和迷走神经紧邻深内侧；避开搏动，绝不向内深刺。

LI19 KǒuhéliáoLI19 口禾髎

Where is LI19 Kǒuhéliáo?口禾髎（LI19）在哪里？

On the face, level with the junction of the upper one third and lower two thirds of the philtrum, directly inferior to the lateral margin of the nostril (GB/T 12346-2021; 0.5 cun lateral to GV26).面部，横平人中沟上 1/3 与下 2/3 交点，鼻孔外缘直下（GB/T 12346-2021；即水沟 GV26 旁开 0.5 寸）。

How is LI19 needled?口禾髎（LI19）怎么刺？

Oblique medially and upward; 0.3–0.5 cun.向内上方斜刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at LI19?口禾髎（LI19）最要注意的安全问题？

Facial artery branches and terminal infraorbital nerve are nearby; avoid vessels and stop for marked electric tingling or bleeding.面动脉分支和眶下神经末梢邻近；避开血管，出现明显电麻感或出血时停止。

LI20 YíngxiāngLI20 迎香

Where is LI20 Yíngxiāng?迎香（LI20）在哪里？

On the face, in the nasolabial groove beside the midpoint of the outer border of the nostril.面部，鼻翼外缘中点旁，鼻唇沟中。

How is LI20 needled?迎香（LI20）怎么刺？

Oblique medially and upward; 0.3–0.5 cun.向内上方斜刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of LI20?迎香（LI20）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Large Intestine and Stomach channels手、足阳明经交会穴

Main safety point at LI20?迎香（LI20）最要注意的安全问题？

Facial and superior labial artery branches and terminal infraorbital nerve are nearby; use only shallow oblique insertion and avoid visible vessels or infected skin.面动脉和上唇动脉分支、眶下神经末梢邻近；仅作浅斜刺，避开可见血管与感染皮肤。

ST1 ChéngqìST1 承泣

Where is ST1 Chéngqì?承泣（ST1）在哪里？

On the face, between the eyeball and the infraorbital margin, directly below the pupil.面部，眼球与眶下缘之间，瞳孔直下。

How is ST1 needled?承泣（ST1）怎么刺？

Push the eyeball gently upward with the guiding thumb and insert slowly and perpendicularly, hugging the infraorbital rim; 0.5–1 cun (textbook maximum 1.5 cun).押手拇指将眼球轻推向上，紧靠眶下缘缓慢直刺；0.5–1 寸（教材上限 1.5 寸）。

Special-point roles of ST1?承泣（ST1）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Stomach channel, Yang Qiao and Ren vessels足阳明、阳跷脉、任脉交会穴

Main safety point at ST1?承泣（ST1）最要注意的安全问题？

A needle angled upward reaches the eyeball and deep insertion can injure orbital vessels or the optic nerve; for eye pressure, proptosis or blurred vision withdraw, compress and seek urgent eye care.针尖偏上会刺向眼球，过深可伤眶内血管与视神经；出现眼胀、眼球突出或视物模糊立即出针压迫并急诊眼科。

ST2 SìbáiST2 四白

Where is ST2 Sìbái?四白（ST2）在哪里？

On the face, in the infraorbital foramen.面部，眶下孔处。

How is ST2 needled?四白（ST2）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or slightly upward oblique; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺或微向上斜刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at ST2?四白（ST2）最要注意的安全问题？

Deep insertion into the foramen can injure the infraorbital nerve and vessels, and deep upward insertion approaches the orbit; stop for lasting facial numbness or periorbital swelling.深刺入眶下孔可伤眶下神经血管，向上过深接近眼眶；出现持续面麻或眶周肿胀应停针。

ST3 JùliáoST3 巨髎

Where is ST3 Jùliáo?巨髎（ST3）在哪里？

On the face, level with the inferior border of the ala of the nose, directly below the pupil.面部，横平鼻翼下缘，瞳孔直下。

How is ST3 needled?巨髎（ST3）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse; 0.3–0.5 cun.斜刺或平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of ST3?巨髎（ST3）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Stomach channel and Yang Qiao vessel足阳明、阳跷脉交会穴

Main safety point at ST3?巨髎（ST3）最要注意的安全问题？

The facial artery runs near the nasolabial groove: avoid any pulse, and press after withdrawal because the face bleeds easily.面动脉在鼻唇沟附近走行，避开搏动；面部血供丰富，出针按压防血肿。

ST4 DìcāngST4 地仓

Where is ST4 Dìcāng?地仓（ST4）在哪里？

On the face, 0.4 cun (finger cun) lateral to the corner of the mouth.面部，口角旁开 0.4 寸（指寸）。

How is ST4 needled?地仓（ST4）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse; may be threaded toward ST6; 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或平刺，可向颊车透刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of ST4?地仓（ST4）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Yang Qiao vessel with the hand and foot Yangming channels (per the Jiayi Jing)阳跷脉与手、足阳明交会穴（据《甲乙经》）

Main safety point at ST4?地仓（ST4）最要注意的安全问题？

Do not pierce through the cheek into the mouth; the facial artery ascends lateral to the mouth corner, so avoid any pulse.不可刺穿颊部进入口腔；面动脉在口角外侧上行，避开搏动。

ST5 DàyíngST5 大迎

Where is ST5 Dàyíng?大迎（ST5）在哪里？

On the face, anterior to the angle of the mandible, in the depression anterior to the masseter attachment, over the facial artery pulse.面部，下颌角前方，咬肌附着部的前缘凹陷中，面动脉搏动处。

How is ST5 needled?大迎（ST5）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse, avoiding the artery; 0.3–0.5 cun.避开动脉，斜刺或平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at ST5?大迎（ST5）最要注意的安全问题？

The facial artery lies under the point: feel the pulse and move away from it before insertion, never into it, and press after withdrawal.面动脉在穴下，进针前先摸到搏动并推开或避开，不可刺入搏动处；出针按压防血肿。

ST6 JiáchēST6 颊车

Where is ST6 Jiáchē?颊车（ST6）在哪里？

On the face, one finger-breadth (middle finger) anterosuperior to the angle of the mandible.面部，下颌角前上方一横指（中指）。

How is ST6 needled?颊车（ST6）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, or transverse threading toward ST4; 0.3–0.5 cun perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun transverse.直刺，或向地仓平刺透刺；直刺 0.3–0.5 寸；平刺 0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at ST6?颊车（ST6）最要注意的安全问题？

Stop at the mandible when needling perpendicularly; avoid opening the mouth wide while needles are retained.直刺抵下颌骨即止；留针时不要大张口。

ST7 XiàguānST7 下关

Where is ST7 Xiàguān?下关（ST7）在哪里？

On the face, in the depression between the midpoint of the inferior border of the zygomatic arch and the mandibular notch.面部，颧弓下缘中央与下颌切迹之间凹陷中。

How is ST7 needled?下关（ST7）怎么刺？

Perpendicular with the mouth closed; 0.5–1 cun.闭口直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of ST7?下关（ST7）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Stomach and Gallbladder channels足阳明、足少阳交会穴

Main safety point at ST7?下关（ST7）最要注意的安全问题？

Deep insertion enters the infratemporal fossa near the maxillary artery and mandibular nerve — withdraw at sharp radiating pain; opening the mouth during retention bends or breaks needles.深刺进入颞下窝可触及上颌动脉与下颌神经，出现剧烈放射痛立即退针；留针时张口会弯针折针。

ST8 TóuwéiST8 头维

Where is ST8 Tóuwéi?头维（ST8）在哪里？

On the head, 0.5 cun directly above the anterior hairline at the corner of the forehead, 4.5 cun lateral to the midline.头部，额角发际直上 0.5 寸，头正中线旁开 4.5 寸。

How is ST8 needled?头维（ST8）怎么刺？

Transverse; 0.5–1 cun.平刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of ST8?头维（ST8）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Stomach and Gallbladder channels and Yang Wei vessel足阳明、足少阳、阳维脉交会穴

Main safety point at ST8?头维（ST8）最要注意的安全问题？

The scalp bleeds easily — press after withdrawal; keep the transverse needle in the subaponeurotic layer.头皮血管丰富，出针按压；平刺在帽状腱膜下层即可。

ST9 RényíngST9 人迎

Where is ST9 Rényíng?人迎（ST9）在哪里？

On the neck, level with the laryngeal prominence, at the anterior border of sternocleidomastoid, over the common carotid artery pulse.颈部，横平喉结，胸锁乳突肌前缘，颈总动脉搏动处。

How is ST9 needled?人迎（ST9）怎么刺？

Push the common carotid artery laterally with the guiding hand and insert perpendicularly away from it; 0.3–0.8 cun.押手把颈总动脉推向外侧，避开动脉直刺；0.3–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of ST9?人迎（ST9）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Stomach and Gallbladder channels; One of the Window of Heaven points足阳明、足少阳交会穴；天牖五部（天窗穴）之一

Main safety point at ST9?人迎（ST9）最要注意的安全问题？

Stimulating the carotid sinus can drop heart rate and blood pressure and cause fainting; puncturing the carotid or jugular can form a neck haematoma that compresses the airway — the Jiayi Jing warns that going too deep can kill.颈动脉窦受刺激可致心率骤降、血压下降和晕厥，刺破颈总动脉或颈内静脉可致颈部血肿压迫气道；《甲乙经》即警告「過深不幸殺人」。

ST10 ShuǐtūST10 水突

Where is ST10 Shuǐtū?水突（ST10）在哪里？

On the neck, level with the cricoid cartilage, at the anterior border of sternocleidomastoid.颈部，横平环状软骨，胸锁乳突肌前缘。

How is ST10 needled?水突（ST10）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, away from any pulse; 0.3–0.8 cun.直刺，避开搏动；0.3–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at ST10?水突（ST10）最要注意的安全问题？

Deep posterolateral insertion reaches the carotid sheath and deep medial insertion the thyroid and recurrent laryngeal nerve; hoarseness, neck swelling or breathing difficulty needs emergency care.向后外深刺可伤颈动脉鞘，向内深刺可伤甲状腺与喉返神经；出现声嘶、颈肿或呼吸困难立即急诊。

ST11 QìshèST11 气舍

Where is ST11 Qìshè?气舍（ST11）在哪里？

In the sternocleidomastoid region, in the lesser supraclavicular fossa, above the sternal end of the clavicle, in the depression between the sternal and clavicular heads of sternocleidomastoid.胸锁乳突肌区，锁骨上小窝，锁骨胸骨端上缘，胸锁乳突肌胸骨头与锁骨头中间的凹陷中。

How is ST11 needled?气舍（ST11）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at ST11?气舍（ST11）最要注意的安全问题？

Deep insertion can injure the common carotid or internal jugular, and deep downward insertion can enter the pleural dome causing pneumothorax; chest pain or breathlessness after needling needs emergency care.深刺可伤颈总动脉、颈内静脉，向下深刺可入胸膜顶致气胸；针后胸痛、气短立即急诊。

ST12 QuēpénST12 缺盆

Where is ST12 Quēpén?缺盆（ST12）在哪里？

In the lateral neck region, in the greater supraclavicular fossa, in the depression above the clavicle, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.颈外侧区，锁骨上大窝，锁骨上缘凹陷中，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is ST12 needled?缺盆（ST12）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique, never downward; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺或斜刺，不向下；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at ST12?缺盆（ST12）最要注意的安全问题？

The pleural dome lies shallow under the fossa: deep or downward insertion can cause pneumothorax and injure the subclavian artery or brachial plexus — the Jiayi Jing warns that deep needling makes the breath rebel. Forbidden in pregnancy.胸膜顶在锁骨上窝深面很浅，深刺或向下刺可致气胸，还可伤锁骨下动脉与臂丛；《甲乙经》警告「刺太深，令人逆息」。孕期禁针。

ST13 QìhùST13 气户

Where is ST13 Qìhù?气户（ST13）在哪里？

On the chest, at the inferior border of the clavicle, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，锁骨下缘，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is ST13 needled?气户（ST13）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse (laterally along the intercostal space); 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或平刺（沿肋间隙向外）；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at ST13?气户（ST13）最要注意的安全问题？

Only 1–2 cm separate skin from pleura (less in thin people): perpendicular or deep insertion can cause pneumothorax; chest pain, breathlessness or worsening cough after needling needs emergency care.胸壁到胸膜只有 1–2 厘米（瘦人更薄），直刺或深刺可致气胸；针后胸痛、气短、咳嗽加重须立即急诊。

ST14 KùfángST14 库房

Where is ST14 Kùfáng?库房（ST14）在哪里？

On the chest, in the 1st intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，第 1 肋间隙，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is ST14 needled?库房（ST14）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse (laterally along the intercostal space); 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或平刺（沿肋间隙向外）；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at ST14?库房（ST14）最要注意的安全问题？

Only 1–2 cm separate skin from pleura (less in thin people): perpendicular or deep insertion can cause pneumothorax; chest pain, breathlessness or worsening cough after needling needs emergency care.胸壁到胸膜只有 1–2 厘米（瘦人更薄），直刺或深刺可致气胸；针后胸痛、气短、咳嗽加重须立即急诊。

ST15 WūyìST15 屋翳

Where is ST15 Wūyì?屋翳（ST15）在哪里？

On the chest, in the 2nd intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，第 2 肋间隙，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is ST15 needled?屋翳（ST15）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse (laterally along the intercostal space); 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或平刺（沿肋间隙向外）；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at ST15?屋翳（ST15）最要注意的安全问题？

Only 1–2 cm separate skin from pleura (less in thin people): perpendicular or deep insertion can cause pneumothorax; chest pain, breathlessness or worsening cough after needling needs emergency care.胸壁到胸膜只有 1–2 厘米（瘦人更薄），直刺或深刺可致气胸；针后胸痛、气短、咳嗽加重须立即急诊。

ST16 YīngchuāngST16 膺窗

Where is ST16 Yīngchuāng?膺窗（ST16）在哪里？

On the chest, in the 3rd intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，第 3 肋间隙，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is ST16 needled?膺窗（ST16）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse (laterally along the intercostal space); 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或平刺（沿肋间隙向外）；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at ST16?膺窗（ST16）最要注意的安全问题？

Only 1–2 cm separate skin from pleura (less in thin people): perpendicular or deep insertion can cause pneumothorax; chest pain, breathlessness or worsening cough after needling needs emergency care.胸壁到胸膜只有 1–2 厘米（瘦人更薄），直刺或深刺可致气胸；针后胸痛、气短、咳嗽加重须立即急诊。

ST17 RǔzhōngST17 乳中

Where is ST17 Rǔzhōng?乳中（ST17）在哪里？

On the chest, at the centre of the nipple.胸部，乳头中央。

How is ST17 needled?乳中（ST17）怎么刺？

Not needled; No needling, no moxibustion.不针；不针不灸。

Special-point roles of ST17?乳中（ST17）是哪类特定穴？

Landmark for locating chest and abdominal points胸腹部腧穴定位标志

Main safety point at ST17?乳中（ST17）最要注意的安全问题？

Forbidden to needle or moxa: the Jiayi Jing records ulceration after treating it, and pleura and lung lie deep. Abnormal nipple discharge or a lump needs breast assessment.禁针禁灸：《甲乙经》记针灸乳中可生蚀疮；深部即胸膜与肺。乳头异常溢液、肿块应乳腺科检查。

ST18 RǔgēnST18 乳根

Where is ST18 Rǔgēn?乳根（ST18）在哪里？

On the chest, in the 5th intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，第 5 肋间隙，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is ST18 needled?乳根（ST18）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse (laterally along the intercostal space); 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或平刺（沿肋间隙向外）；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at ST18?乳根（ST18）最要注意的安全问题？

Special-point roles of ST43?陷谷（ST43）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream (wood) point输穴（木）

Main safety point at ST43?陷谷（ST43）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid dorsal veins; do not needle broken skin, fungal infection, cellulitis or a diabetic foot; the foot is sensitive, so keep shallow.避开足背浅静脉，足部皮损、真菌感染、蜂窝织炎或糖尿病足不针；足部针感较痛，宜浅刺。

ST44 NèitíngST44 内庭

Where is ST44 Nèitíng?内庭（ST44）在哪里？

On the dorsum of the foot, between the 2nd and 3rd toes, proximal to the web margin, at the border between the red and white flesh.足背，第 2、3 趾间，趾蹼缘后方赤白肉际处。

How is ST44 needled?内庭（ST44）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of ST44?内庭（ST44）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring (water) point荥穴（水）

Main safety point at ST44?内庭（ST44）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid dorsal veins; do not needle broken skin, fungal infection, cellulitis or a diabetic foot; the foot is sensitive, so keep shallow.避开足背浅静脉，足部皮损、真菌感染、蜂窝织炎或糖尿病足不针；足部针感较痛，宜浅刺。

ST45 LìduìST45 厉兑

Where is ST45 Lìduì?厉兑（ST45）在哪里？

On the toe, on the lateral side of the distal phalanx of the 2nd toe, 0.1 cun (finger cun) proximal-lateral to the corner of the toenail.足趾，第 2 趾末节外侧，趾甲根角侧后方 0.1 寸（指寸）。

How is ST45 needled?厉兑（ST45）怎么刺？

Shallow insertion, or prick to bleed; 0.1 cun.浅刺；或点刺出血；0.1 寸。

Special-point roles of ST45?厉兑（ST45）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well (metal) point; child point of the Stomach channel井穴（金）；胃经子穴

Main safety point at ST45?厉兑（ST45）最要注意的安全问题？

Strict asepsis before pricking; do not needle paronychia, an ingrown nail, foot infection or a diabetic foot; no bloodletting with a bleeding tendency.点刺前严格消毒；甲沟炎、嵌甲、足部感染或糖尿病足不针；出血倾向者不点刺放血。

SP1 YǐnbáiSP1 隐白

Where is SP1 Yǐnbái?隐白（SP1）在哪里？

On the great toe, medial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 F-cun proximal-medial to the medial corner of the toenail.足趾，大趾末节内侧，趾甲根角侧后方 0.1 寸（指寸）。

How is SP1 needled?隐白（SP1）怎么刺？

Shallow insertion; 0.1 cun.浅刺；0.1 寸。

Special-point roles of SP1?隐白（SP1）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well (wood)井穴（木）

Main safety point at SP1?隐白（SP1）最要注意的安全问题？

The distal phalanx is right beneath with the nail bed beside it: stay shallow; guard against burns with direct moxibustion and avoid it in diabetic feet or reduced sensation.针下即是末节趾骨，甲床在旁：浅刺即止；直接灸时防烫伤，糖尿病足、感觉减退者不用直接灸。

SP2 DàdūSP2 大都

Where is SP2 Dàdū?大都（SP2）在哪里？

On the great toe, in the depression distal to the first metatarsophalangeal joint, at the border of the red and white flesh.足趾，第 1 跖趾关节远端赤白肉际凹陷中。

How is SP2 needled?大都（SP2）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SP2?大都（SP2）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring (fire)荥穴（火）

Main safety point at SP2?大都（SP2）最要注意的安全问题？

Thin skin over shallow bone: stay shallow and keep out of the metatarsophalangeal joint capsule.皮薄骨浅：浅刺，不刺入跖趾关节囊。

SP3 TàibáiSP3 太白

Where is SP3 Tàibái?太白（SP3）在哪里？

On the medial foot, in the depression proximal to the first metatarsophalangeal joint, at the border of the red and white flesh.跖区，第 1 跖趾关节近端赤白肉际凹陷中。

How is SP3 needled?太白（SP3）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of SP3?太白（SP3）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream (earth), Yuan-source point输穴（土）、原穴

Main safety point at SP3?太白（SP3）最要注意的安全问题？

Tissue along the medial foot is thin: stop at the bone without forcing, and avoid visible veins.足内侧缘皮下组织薄，遇骨面即止，不强行抵骨；避开可见静脉。

SP4 GōngsūnSP4 公孙

Where is SP4 Gōngsūn?公孙（SP4）在哪里？

On the medial foot, anteroinferior to the base of the first metatarsal bone, at the border of the red and white flesh.跖区，第 1 跖骨底的前下缘赤白肉际处。

How is SP4 needled?公孙（SP4）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.6–1.2 cun.直刺；0.6–1.2 寸。

Special-point roles of SP4?公孙（SP4）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point; Confluent point of the eight extraordinary vessels (Chong vessel)络穴；八脉交会穴（通冲脉）

Main safety point at SP4?公孙（SP4）最要注意的安全问题？

Insert along the lower edge of the metatarsal base; back off and redirect on striking bone. Branches of the medial plantar nerve are deep—withdraw at electric tingling.沿跖骨底下缘直刺，遇骨即稍退调整方向；足底内侧神经分支在深部，出现放射样电麻感即退针。

SP5 ShāngqiūSP5 商丘

Where is SP5 Shāngqiū?商丘（SP5）在哪里？

On the medial ankle, anteroinferior to the medial malleolus, in the depression midway between the tuberosity of the navicular and the prominence of the medial malleolus.踝区，内踝前下方，舟骨粗隆与内踝尖连线中点凹陷中。

How is SP5 needled?商丘（SP5）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of SP5?商丘（SP5）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river (metal)经穴（金）

Main safety point at SP5?商丘（SP5）最要注意的安全问题？

Superficial veins are plentiful in front of and below the malleolus: identify them first, and keep the needle out of the talonavicular joint.内踝前下方浅静脉多：先看清静脉；针不刺入距舟关节腔。

SP6 SānyīnjiāoSP6 三阴交

Where is SP6 Sānyīnjiāo?三阴交（SP6）在哪里？

On the medial leg, 3 cun above the prominence of the medial malleolus, posterior to the medial border of the tibia.小腿内侧，内踝尖上 3 寸，胫骨内侧缘后际。

How is SP6 needled?三阴交（SP6）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SP6?三阴交（SP6）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Spleen, Kidney and Liver channels足太阴、足少阴、足厥阴经交会穴

Main safety point at SP6?三阴交（SP6）最要注意的安全问题？

Contraindicated in pregnancy (classically, reducing SP6 with reinforcing LI4 was recorded to induce delivery). Avoid the great saphenous vein; do not angle deep posteromedially toward the posterior tibial vessels and tibial nerve, and withdraw at electric tingling into the sole.孕妇禁针（《铜人》以泻三阴交、补合谷下胎为戒）。避开大隐静脉；针不向后内侧深刺，以免伤胫后血管与胫神经，出现向足底放射的电麻感即退针。

SP7 LòugǔSP7 漏谷

Where is SP7 Lòugǔ?漏谷（SP7）在哪里？

On the medial leg, 6 cun above the prominence of the medial malleolus, posterior to the medial border of the tibia.小腿内侧，内踝尖上 6 寸，胫骨内侧缘后际。

How is SP7 needled?漏谷（SP7）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Main safety point at SP7?漏谷（SP7）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid the great saphenous vein; do not angle deep posteromedially into the posterior tibial neurovascular bundle.避开大隐静脉；针不向后内侧深刺至胫后血管神经束。

SP8 DìjīSP8 地机

Where is SP8 Dìjī?地机（SP8）在哪里？

On the medial leg, 3 cun below SP9, posterior to the medial border of the tibia.小腿内侧，阴陵泉下 3 寸，胫骨内侧缘后际。

How is SP8 needled?地机（SP8）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SP8?地机（SP8）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point郄穴

Main safety point at SP8?地机（SP8）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid the great saphenous vein; do not angle deep posteromedially.避开大隐静脉；不向后内侧深刺。

SP9 YīnlíngquánSP9 阴陵泉

Where is SP9 Yīnlíngquán?阴陵泉（SP9）在哪里？

On the medial leg, in the depression between the inferior border of the medial condyle of the tibia and the medial border of the tibia.小腿内侧，胫骨内侧髁下缘与胫骨内侧缘之间的凹陷中。

How is SP9 needled?阴陵泉（SP9）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–2 cun.直刺；1–2 寸。

Special-point roles of SP9?阴陵泉（SP9）是哪类特定穴？

He-sea (water)合穴（水）

Main safety point at SP9?阴陵泉（SP9）最要注意的安全问题？

The great saphenous vein usually passes superficially: identify it first, and do not drive deep posteriorly toward the posterior tibial neurovascular bundle.大隐静脉多在浅层经过：先看清；针不向后方深刺至胫后血管神经束。

SP10 XuèhǎiSP10 血海

Where is SP10 Xuèhǎi?血海（SP10）在哪里？

On the anteromedial thigh, 2 cun above the medial end of the base of the patella, on the bulge of vastus medialis.股前区，髌底内侧端上 2 寸，股内侧肌隆起处。

How is SP10 needled?血海（SP10）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Main safety point at SP10?血海（SP10）最要注意的安全问题？

Thick vastus medialis lies beneath, so it is relatively safe; avoid superficial veins and do not aim toward the suprapatellar bursa or knee joint.针下是厚实的股内侧肌，较安全；避开浅静脉，针不朝髌上囊与膝关节腔。

SP11 JīménSP11 箕门

Where is SP11 Jīmén?箕门（SP11）在哪里？

On the medial thigh, at the junction of the upper third and lower two thirds of the line from the medial end of the patellar base to SP12, at the angle between adductor longus and sartorius, over the femoral artery.股前区，髌底内侧端与冲门的连线上 1/3 与下 2/3 交点，长收肌和缝匠肌交角的动脉搏动处。

How is SP11 needled?箕门（SP11）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, avoiding the artery; 0.5–1 cun.直刺，避开动脉；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at SP11?箕门（SP11）最要注意的安全问题？

The femoral artery and vein lie directly beneath: palpate the pulse, enter beside it, stay shallow without lifting-thrusting, and apply sustained pressure if the artery is punctured.股动静脉就在穴下：先摸清搏动，针从搏动旁避开进入，浅刺不提插；刺破动脉须持续压迫。

SP12 ChōngménSP12 冲门

Where is SP12 Chōngmén?冲门（SP12）在哪里？

In the groin region, at the inguinal crease, lateral to the pulsation of the external iliac (femoral) artery.腹股沟区，腹股沟斜纹中，髂外动脉搏动处的外侧。

How is SP12 needled?冲门（SP12）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, avoiding the artery; 0.5–1 cun.直刺，避开动脉；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of SP12?冲门（SP12）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Spleen and Liver channels足太阴、足厥阴经交会穴

Main safety point at SP12?冲门（SP12）最要注意的安全问题？

Contraindicated in pregnancy. The femoral artery is medial and the femoral nerve beneath: palpate the pulse, insert perpendicularly lateral to it, never angle medially, go deep or lift-thrust, and withdraw at electric tingling down the front of the thigh.孕期禁针。股动脉在内侧、股神经在穴下：先摸清搏动，针在其外侧直刺，不向内侧斜刺、不深刺不提插；出现向大腿前面放射的电麻感即退针。

SP13 FǔshěSP13 府舍

Where is SP13 Fǔshě?府舍（SP13）在哪里？

On the lower abdomen, 4.3 cun below the centre of the umbilicus and 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.下腹部，脐中下 4.3 寸，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is SP13 needled?府舍（SP13）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SP13?府舍（SP13）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Spleen and Liver channels and the Yin Linking vessel足太阴、足厥阴经与阴维脉交会穴

Main safety point at SP13?府舍（SP13）最要注意的安全问题？

Contraindicated in pregnancy. The bowel lies beyond the peritoneum and wall thickness varies: the textbook depth is a ceiling, go shallower in thin people, avoid wide lifting-thrusting, and do not needle unexplained acute abdominal pain.孕期禁针。腹膜深面是肠管，腹壁厚薄因人而异：教材深度是上限，消瘦者减浅，不大幅提插；急性腹痛原因未明不针。

SP14 FùjiéSP14 腹结

Where is SP14 Fùjié?腹结（SP14）在哪里？

On the lower abdomen, 1.3 cun below the centre of the umbilicus and 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.下腹部，脐中下 1.3 寸，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is SP14 needled?腹结（SP14）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–2 cun.直刺；1–2 寸。

Main safety point at SP14?腹结（SP14）最要注意的安全问题？

Contraindicated in pregnancy. The bowel lies beyond the peritoneum and wall thickness varies: the textbook depth is a ceiling, go shallower in thin people, avoid wide lifting-thrusting, and do not needle unexplained acute abdominal pain.孕期禁针。腹膜深面是肠管，腹壁厚薄因人而异：教材深度是上限，消瘦者减浅，不大幅提插；急性腹痛原因未明不针。

SP15 DàhéngSP15 大横

Where is SP15 Dàhéng?大横（SP15）在哪里？

On the abdomen, 4 cun lateral to the centre of the umbilicus.腹部，脐中旁开 4 寸。

How is SP15 needled?大横（SP15）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–2 cun.直刺；1–2 寸。

Special-point roles of SP15?大横（SP15）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Spleen channel and the Yin Linking vessel足太阴经与阴维脉交会穴

Main safety point at SP15?大横（SP15）最要注意的安全问题？

Contraindicated in pregnancy. The bowel lies beyond the peritoneum and wall thickness varies: the textbook depth is a ceiling, go shallower in thin people, avoid wide lifting-thrusting, and do not needle unexplained acute abdominal pain.孕期禁针。腹膜深面是肠管，腹壁厚薄因人而异：教材深度是上限，消瘦者减浅，不大幅提插；急性腹痛原因未明不针。

SP16 Fù'āiSP16 腹哀

Where is SP16 Fù'āi?腹哀（SP16）在哪里？

On the upper abdomen, 3 cun above the centre of the umbilicus and 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.上腹部，脐中上 3 寸，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is SP16 needled?腹哀（SP16）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SP16?腹哀（SP16）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Spleen channel and the Yin Linking vessel足太阴经与阴维脉交会穴

Main safety point at SP16?腹哀（SP16）最要注意的安全问题？

Contraindicated in pregnancy. The lower liver edge and gallbladder lie deep on the right and the stomach on the left: go shallower with an enlarged liver, after a full meal or in thin people, avoid wide lifting-thrusting, and do not needle unexplained acute abdominal pain.孕期禁针。深面右侧邻肝下缘与胆囊、左侧邻胃：肝大、饱食或腹壁薄者减浅，不大幅提插；急性腹痛原因未明不针。

SP17 ShídòuSP17 食窦

Where is SP17 Shídòu?食窦（SP17）在哪里？

On the lateral chest, in the 5th intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，第 5 肋间隙，前正中线旁开 6 寸。

How is SP17 needled?食窦（SP17）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse outward; 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或向外平刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at SP17?食窦（SP17）最要注意的安全问题？

Pleura and lung lie just deep to the intercostal muscles and the chest wall is thin here: insert only obliquely or transversely outward, never perpendicularly or deep medially—risk of pneumothorax; avoid the intercostal vessels and nerve.肋间肌深面就是胸膜和肺，此处胸壁薄：只斜刺或向外平刺，不直刺、不向内深刺，有气胸风险；避开肋间血管神经。

SP18 TiānxīSP18 天溪

Where is SP18 Tiānxī?天溪（SP18）在哪里？

On the lateral chest, in the 4th intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，第 4 肋间隙，前正中线旁开 6 寸。

How is SP18 needled?天溪（SP18）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse outward; 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或向外平刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at SP18?天溪（SP18）最要注意的安全问题？

Pleura and lung lie just deep to the intercostal muscles and the chest wall is thin here: insert only obliquely or transversely outward, never perpendicularly or deep medially—risk of pneumothorax; avoid the intercostal vessels and nerve.肋间肌深面就是胸膜和肺，此处胸壁薄：只斜刺或向外平刺，不直刺、不向内深刺，有气胸风险；避开肋间血管神经。

SP19 XiōngxiāngSP19 胸乡

Where is SP19 Xiōngxiāng?胸乡（SP19）在哪里？

On the lateral chest, in the 3rd intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，第 3 肋间隙，前正中线旁开 6 寸。

How is SP19 needled?胸乡（SP19）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse outward; 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或向外平刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at SP19?胸乡（SP19）最要注意的安全问题？

Pleura and lung lie just deep to the intercostal muscles and the chest wall is thin here: insert only obliquely or transversely outward, never perpendicularly or deep medially—risk of pneumothorax; avoid the intercostal vessels and nerve.肋间肌深面就是胸膜和肺，此处胸壁薄：只斜刺或向外平刺，不直刺、不向内深刺，有气胸风险；避开肋间血管神经。

SP20 ZhōuróngSP20 周荣

Where is SP20 Zhōuróng?周荣（SP20）在哪里？

On the lateral chest, in the 2nd intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，第 2 肋间隙，前正中线旁开 6 寸。

How is SP20 needled?周荣（SP20）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse outward; 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或向外平刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at SP20?周荣（SP20）最要注意的安全问题？

Pleura and lung lie just deep to the intercostal muscles and the chest wall is thin here: insert only obliquely or transversely outward, never perpendicularly or deep medially—risk of pneumothorax; avoid the intercostal vessels and nerve.肋间肌深面就是胸膜和肺，此处胸壁薄：只斜刺或向外平刺，不直刺、不向内深刺，有气胸风险；避开肋间血管神经。

SP21 DàbāoSP21 大包

Where is SP21 Dàbāo?大包（SP21）在哪里？

On the lateral chest, in the 6th intercostal space, on the mid-axillary line.胸外侧区，第 6 肋间隙，在腋中线上。

How is SP21 needled?大包（SP21）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse posteriorly; 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或向后平刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of SP21?大包（SP21）是哪类特定穴？

Great luo-connecting point of the Spleen脾之大络

Main safety point at SP21?大包（SP21）最要注意的安全问题？

The lateral chest wall is thin with pleura and lung just deep to the intercostals: insert only obliquely or transversely backward along the space, never perpendicularly or deep medially—risk of pneumothorax.侧胸壁薄，肋间肌深面就是胸膜和肺：只斜刺或沿肋间向后平刺，不直刺、不向内深刺，有气胸风险。

HT1 JíquánHT1 极泉

Where is HT1 Jíquán?极泉（HT1）在哪里？

In the axilla, at the centre of the axillary fossa, over the pulsation of the axillary artery.腋区，腋窝中央，腋动脉搏动处。

How is HT1 needled?极泉（HT1）怎么刺？

With the arm abducted, perpendicular or oblique, avoiding the axillary artery; 0.3–0.5 cun.上臂外展，避开腋动脉，直刺或斜刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of HT1?极泉（HT1）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Heart channel手少阴心经穴

Main safety point at HT1?极泉（HT1）最要注意的安全问题？

The axillary artery, vein and brachial plexus lie directly beneath: insert shallowly, never aim at the pulse, and withdraw at once for an electric-shock sensation; deep insertion medially toward the chest wall can pass an intercostal space and injure the pleura.腋动、静脉与臂丛就在穴下：只浅刺，针尖不朝搏动点；出现电击样麻感立即退针；向内侧胸壁深刺可穿过肋间隙伤及胸膜。

HT2 QīnglíngHT2 青灵

Where is HT2 Qīnglíng?青灵（HT2）在哪里？

On the anteromedial upper arm, 3 cun above the cubital crease, in the medial bicipital groove.臂前区，肘横纹上 3 寸，肱二头肌的内侧沟中。

How is HT2 needled?青灵（HT2）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, avoiding the brachial artery; 0.5–1 cun.直刺，避开肱动脉；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of HT2?青灵（HT2）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Heart channel; listed among the classical forbidden-to-needle points手少阴心经穴；古代禁针穴之一

Main safety point at HT2?青灵（HT2）最要注意的安全问题？

The brachial artery and median nerve run in the groove: feel the pulse and insert away from it, never deep over it; withdraw for tingling radiating to the forearm or fingers. The Zhenjiu Dacheng lists Qingling as forbidden to needle; with modern filiform needles it may be needled away from the bundle, but carefully.肱动脉与正中神经就在沟内：先摸清搏动再避开进针，不在搏动处深刺；出现向前臂、手指放射的麻感即退针。《针灸大成》把青灵列入禁针穴，现代用毫针避开血管神经可刺，但不可大意。

HT3 ShàohǎiHT3 少海

Where is HT3 Shàohǎi?少海（HT3）在哪里？

On the anteromedial elbow, level with the cubital crease, at the anterior border of the medial epicondyle of the humerus.肘前区，横平肘横纹，肱骨内上髁前缘。

How is HT3 needled?少海（HT3）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of HT3?少海（HT3）是哪类特定穴？

He-sea (water)合穴（水）

Main safety point at HT3?少海（HT3）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid the basilic vein; do not angle behind the medial epicondyle, where the ulnar nerve lies in its groove; withdraw for tingling into the little finger.避开贵要静脉；针尖不向内上髁后方偏，那里是尺神经沟；出现向小指放射的麻感即退针。

HT4 LíngdàoHT4 灵道

Where is HT4 Língdào?灵道（HT4）在哪里？

On the anterior forearm, 1.5 cun above the distal palmar wrist crease, radial to the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris.前臂前区，腕掌侧远端横纹上 1.5 寸，尺侧腕屈肌腱的桡侧缘。

How is HT4 needled?灵道（HT4）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of HT4?灵道（HT4）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river (metal)经穴（金）

Main safety point at HT4?灵道（HT4）最要注意的安全问题？

The ulnar artery and nerve lie directly beneath, deep to the radial edge of the tendon: insert shallowly, avoid the pulse, and withdraw at once for electric tingling into the little and ring fingers.尺动脉、尺神经在腱桡侧深面就在穴下：只浅刺，避开搏动；出现向小指、环指放射的电麻感立即退针。

HT5 TōnglǐHT5 通里

Where is HT5 Tōnglǐ?通里（HT5）在哪里？

On the anterior forearm, 1 cun above the distal palmar wrist crease, radial to the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris.前臂前区，腕掌侧远端横纹上 1 寸，尺侧腕屈肌腱的桡侧缘。

How is HT5 needled?通里（HT5）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of HT5?通里（HT5）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point络穴

Main safety point at HT5?通里（HT5）最要注意的安全问题？

The ulnar artery and nerve lie deep to the radial edge of the tendon: insert shallowly, away from the pulse and visible veins; withdraw for tingling into the little finger and do not chase needle sensation.尺动脉、尺神经就在腱桡侧的深面：浅刺、避开搏动和可见静脉；有向小指放射的麻感即退针，不追求针感。

HT6 YīnxìHT6 阴郄

Where is HT6 Yīnxì?阴郄（HT6）在哪里？

On the anterior forearm, 0.5 cun above the distal palmar wrist crease, radial to the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris.前臂前区，腕掌侧远端横纹上 0.5 寸，尺侧腕屈肌腱的桡侧缘。

How is HT6 needled?阴郄（HT6）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of HT6?阴郄（HT6）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point郄穴

Main safety point at HT6?阴郄（HT6）最要注意的安全问题？

The ulnar artery and nerve are shallow here: feel the pulse, insert shallowly away from it, withdraw for electric tingling, and press after withdrawal to prevent a haematoma.尺动脉、尺神经在此很浅：先摸清搏动，避开后浅刺；出现电麻感即退针，出针后按压防血肿。

HT7 ShénménHT7 神门

Where is HT7 Shénmén?神门（HT7）在哪里？

On the anteromedial wrist, at the ulnar end of the distal palmar wrist crease, radial to the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris.腕前区，腕掌侧远端横纹尺侧端，尺侧腕屈肌腱的桡侧缘。

How is HT7 needled?神门（HT7）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of HT7?神门（HT7）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream (earth), Yuan-source point输穴（土）、原穴

Main safety point at HT7?神门（HT7）最要注意的安全问题？

The ulnar artery and nerve are directly beneath: feel the ulnar pulse first, insert shallowly hugging the radial edge of the tendon, without lifting-thrusting; withdraw at once for electric tingling into the little and ring fingers.尺动脉、尺神经就在穴下：先摸清尺动脉搏动，紧贴腱的桡侧缘浅刺，不提插；出现向小指、环指放射的电麻感立即退针。

HT8 ShàofǔHT8 少府

Where is HT8 Shàofǔ?少府（HT8）在哪里？

On the palm, level with the proximal border of the 5th metacarpophalangeal joint, between the 4th and 5th metacarpals.手掌，横平第 5 掌指关节近端，第 4、5 掌骨之间。

How is HT8 needled?少府（HT8）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of HT8?少府（HT8）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring (fire)荥穴（火）

Main safety point at HT8?少府（HT8）最要注意的安全问题？

Insert with the palm relaxed, avoiding the flexor tendons and the common palmar digital nerve and vessels beside them; withdraw for electric tingling into the ring or little finger, and press after withdrawal.手掌放松后进针，避开屈肌腱和腱旁的指掌侧总神经、血管；有向环指、小指放射的电麻感即退针，出针后按压。

HT9 ShàochōngHT9 少冲

Where is HT9 Shàochōng?少冲（HT9）在哪里？

On the little finger, radial to the distal phalanx, 0.1 F-cun proximal-lateral to the radial corner of the nail.手指，小指末节桡侧，指甲根角侧上方 0.1 寸（指寸）。

How is HT9 needled?少冲（HT9）怎么刺？

Shallow insertion, or prick to bleed; 0.1 cun.浅刺，或点刺出血；0.1 寸。

Special-point roles of HT9?少冲（HT9）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well (wood)井穴（木）

Main safety point at HT9?少冲（HT9）最要注意的安全问题？

The tissue is very thin over bone: shallow insertion or pricking only, never into the nail bed or matrix; do not needle over paronychia, injury or a cold, ischaemic fingertip.组织极薄、贴着骨面：只浅刺或点刺，不刺入甲床、甲母质；甲沟炎、外伤或指端缺血处不针。

SI1 ShàozéSI1 少泽

Where is SI1 Shàozé?少泽（SI1）在哪里？

On the little finger, ulnar to the distal phalanx, 0.1 F-cun proximal-lateral to the ulnar corner of the nail.手指，小指末节尺侧，指甲根角侧上方 0.1 寸（指寸）。

How is SI1 needled?少泽（SI1）怎么刺？

Shallow insertion; 0.1 cun, or prick to bleed.浅刺；0.1 寸，或点刺出血。

Special-point roles of SI1?少泽（SI1）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well (metal)井穴（金）

Main safety point at SI1?少泽（SI1）最要注意的安全问题？

The fingertip is very sensitive: shallow or pricking insertion only, strict asepsis, keep off the nail bed and do not squeeze repeatedly.指端痛觉敏感，只作浅刺或点刺；严格消毒，避开甲床，不反复挤压。

SI2 QiángǔSI2 前谷

Where is SI2 Qiángǔ?前谷（SI2）在哪里？

On the little finger, in the depression distal to the ulnar side of the 5th metacarpophalangeal joint, at the border between the red and white skin.手指，第 5 掌指关节尺侧远端赤白肉际凹陷中。

How is SI2 needled?前谷（SI2）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SI2?前谷（SI2）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring (water)荥穴（水）

Main safety point at SI2?前谷（SI2）最要注意的安全问题？

The digital nerve and artery run along the side of the finger: do not drive along the edge, and withdraw for tingling that shoots to the fingertip.指神经与指动脉沿手指侧缘走行，针向不要贴侧缘深入；出现向指尖放射的麻感即退针。

SI3 HòuxīSI3 后溪

Where is SI3 Hòuxī?后溪（SI3）在哪里？

On the ulnar side of the hand, in the depression proximal to the 5th metacarpophalangeal joint, at the border between the red and white skin.手内侧，第 5 掌指关节尺侧近端赤白肉际凹陷中。

How is SI3 needled?后溪（SI3）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of SI3?后溪（SI3）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream (wood); confluent point of the Governor vessel输穴（木）；八脉交会穴，通督脉

Main safety point at SI3?后溪（SI3）最要注意的安全问题？

The dorsal venous network and the dorsal ulnar nerve branch are superficial: insert along the lower edge of the metacarpal, avoid visible veins, and withdraw for shooting tingling.手背静脉网与尺神经手背支在浅层；沿掌骨下缘进针，避开可见静脉，出现窜麻退针。

SI4 WàngǔSI4 腕骨

Where is SI4 Wàngǔ?腕骨（SI4）在哪里？

On the wrist, in the depression between the base of the 5th metacarpal and the triquetrum, at the border between the red and white skin.腕区，第 5 掌骨底与三角骨之间的赤白肉际凹陷中。

How is SI4 needled?腕骨（SI4）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SI4?腕骨（SI4）是哪类特定穴？

Yuan-source原穴

Main safety point at SI4?腕骨（SI4）最要注意的安全问题？

The joint gap is narrow: stop on bone, never force deeper, and avoid the superficial dorsal veins.骨间隙窄，遇骨即止，不强行深刺；避开手背浅静脉。

SI5 YánggǔSI5 阳谷

Where is SI5 Yánggǔ?阳谷（SI5）在哪里？

On the posteromedial wrist, in the depression between the ulnar styloid process and the triquetrum.腕后区，尺骨茎突与三角骨之间的凹陷中。

How is SI5 needled?阳谷（SI5）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SI5?阳谷（SI5）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river (fire)经穴（火）

Main safety point at SI5?阳谷（SI5）最要注意的安全问题？

The dorsal branch of the ulnar nerve winds superficially to the back of the hand here: withdraw for tingling into the back of the little finger, and do not enter the joint.尺神经手背支在此处浅出绕至手背，出现向小指背侧放射的麻感即退针；不刺入关节腔。

SI6 YǎnglǎoSI6 养老

Where is SI6 Yǎnglǎo?养老（SI6）在哪里？

On the posterior forearm, 1 cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease, in the depression radial to the head of the ulna.前臂后区，腕背横纹上 1 寸，尺骨头桡侧凹陷中。

How is SI6 needled?养老（SI6）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of SI6?养老（SI6）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft郄穴

Main safety point at SI6?养老（SI6）最要注意的安全问题？

Find the cleft in supination first; needling palm-down hits the ulnar head. Do not enter the distal radioulnar joint.要在旋后位找到骨缝再进针，掌心向下直接扎会顶在尺骨头上；不刺入桡尺远侧关节腔。

SI7 ZhīzhèngSI7 支正

Where is SI7 Zhīzhèng?支正（SI7）在哪里？

On the posteromedial forearm, 5 cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease, between the medial border of the ulna and the flexor carpi ulnaris.前臂后区，腕背横纹上 5 寸，尺骨尺侧与尺侧腕屈肌之间。

How is SI7 needled?支正（SI7）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of SI7?支正（SI7）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting络穴

Main safety point at SI7?支正（SI7）最要注意的安全问题？

Keep the needle along the ulnar border: angling deep toward the palm side nears the ulnar nerve and artery; withdraw for tingling into the little finger.针贴尺骨缘进针；向掌侧深刺会接近尺神经与尺动脉，出现向小指放射的麻感即退针。

SI8 XiǎohǎiSI8 小海

Where is SI8 Xiǎohǎi?小海（SI8）在哪里？

On the posteromedial elbow, in the depression between the olecranon and the medial epicondyle of the humerus.肘后区，尺骨鹰嘴与肱骨内上髁之间凹陷中。

How is SI8 needled?小海（SI8）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SI8?小海（SI8）是哪类特定穴？

He-sea (earth)合穴（土）

Main safety point at SI8?小海（SI8）最要注意的安全问题？

The ulnar nerve lies directly beneath the point: shallow insertion only, no lifting-thrusting, and withdraw at once for an electric-shock sensation.尺神经就在穴位正下方：只可浅刺，不提插；出现电击样麻感立即退针。

SI9 JiānzhēnSI9 肩贞

Where is SI9 Jiānzhēn?肩贞（SI9）在哪里？

In the scapular region, posteroinferior to the shoulder joint, 1 cun superior to the posterior axillary fold.肩胛区，肩关节后下方，腋后纹头直上 1 寸。

How is SI9 needled?肩贞（SI9）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SI9?肩贞（SI9）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Small Intestine channel手太阳小肠经穴

Main safety point at SI9?肩贞（SI9）最要注意的安全问题？

The radial and axillary nerves and posterior circumflex humeral vessels lie deep: insert perpendicular or slightly lateral, never deep toward the axilla, and withdraw for radiating tingling.深处有桡神经、腋神经和旋肱后血管；直刺或略向外，不可向腋窝内侧深刺，出现放射样麻感退针。

SI10 NàoshūSI10 臑俞

Where is SI10 Nàoshū?臑俞（SI10）在哪里？

In the scapular region, directly superior to the posterior axillary fold, in the depression inferior to the scapular spine.肩胛区，腋后纹头直上，肩胛冈下缘凹陷中。

How is SI10 needled?臑俞（SI10）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–1.5 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SI10?臑俞（SI10）是哪类特定穴？

Meeting point of the Hand-Taiyang channel with the Yang Wei and Yang Qiao vessels手太阳、阳维脉、阳跷脉交会穴

Main safety point at SI10?臑俞（SI10）最要注意的安全问题？

The suprascapular nerve and vessels lie deep: aim toward the scapula, not deep toward the axilla, and withdraw for shooting tingling.深面有肩胛上神经血管；针向肩胛骨面，不向腋窝方向深刺，出现窜麻退针。

SI11 TiānzōngSI11 天宗

Where is SI11 Tiānzōng?天宗（SI11）在哪里？

In the scapular region, in the depression at the junction of the upper one third and lower two thirds of the line connecting the midpoint of the scapular spine with the inferior angle of the scapula.肩胛区，肩胛冈中点与肩胛骨下角连线上 1/3 与下 2/3 交点凹陷中。

How is SI11 needled?天宗（SI11）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–1 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of SI11?天宗（SI11）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Small Intestine channel手太阳小肠经穴

Main safety point at SI11?天宗（SI11）最要注意的安全问题？

Bone lies beneath: stop on bone and never force. If the point drifts beyond the lateral border of the scapula, deep insertion can enter the intercostal space and puncture the pleura (pneumothorax).针下是肩胛骨，碰骨即止，不可强行进针；取穴偏到肩胛骨外缘之外再深刺，会进入肋间、刺破胸膜引起气胸。

SI12 BǐngfēngSI12 秉风

Where is SI12 Bǐngfēng?秉风（SI12）在哪里？

In the scapular region, in the supraspinous fossa, superior to the midpoint of the scapular spine.肩胛区，肩胛冈中点上方冈上窝中。

How is SI12 needled?秉风（SI12）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–1 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of SI12?秉风（SI12）是哪类特定穴？

Meeting point of the three Hand-Yang channels and Foot-Shaoyang手三阳、足少阳交会穴

Main safety point at SI12?秉风（SI12）最要注意的安全问题？

Aim at the bone of the supraspinous fossa and stop on bone; never pass over the superior border of the scapula and go deep medially, which can reach the pleural dome.针向冈上窝骨面，碰骨即止；不可越过肩胛骨上缘向内下深刺，以免刺及胸膜顶。

SI13 QūyuánSI13 曲垣

Where is SI13 Qūyuán?曲垣（SI13）在哪里？

In the scapular region, in the depression superior to the medial end of the scapular spine.肩胛区，肩胛冈内侧端上缘凹陷中。

How is SI13 needled?曲垣（SI13）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–1 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of SI13?曲垣（SI13）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Small Intestine channel手太阳小肠经穴

Main safety point at SI13?曲垣（SI13）最要注意的安全问题？

The pleura and lung apex lie deep superomedially: aim laterally and downward onto the supraspinous fossa, never deep medially, downward or toward the supraclavicular fossa.内上方深面是胸膜和肺尖：针向外下、贴冈上窝骨面，不可向内下或锁骨上窝方向深刺。

SI14 JiānwàishūSI14 肩外俞

Where is SI14 Jiānwàishū?肩外俞（SI14）在哪里？

In the upper back, at the level of the inferior border of the T1 spinous process, 3 cun lateral to the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 1 胸椎棘突下，后正中线旁开 3 寸。

How is SI14 needled?肩外俞（SI14）怎么刺？

Oblique; 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of SI14?肩外俞（SI14）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Small Intestine channel手太阳小肠经穴

Main safety point at SI14?肩外俞（SI14）最要注意的安全问题？

The intercostal space, pleura and lung apex lie directly deep: shallow oblique insertion only, never deep perpendicular, never medially and downward.深面就是肋间隙、胸膜与肺尖：只作浅斜刺，不可直刺深刺，不向内下方进针。

SI15 JiānzhōngshūSI15 肩中俞

Where is SI15 Jiānzhōngshū?肩中俞（SI15）在哪里？

In the upper back, at the level of the inferior border of the C7 spinous process, 2 cun lateral to the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 7 颈椎棘突下，后正中线旁开 2 寸。

How is SI15 needled?肩中俞（SI15）怎么刺？

Oblique; 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of SI15?肩中俞（SI15）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Small Intestine channel手太阳小肠经穴

Main safety point at SI15?肩中俞（SI15）最要注意的安全问题？

The pleural dome and lung apex lie deep: shallow oblique insertion only, never deep perpendicular and never toward the chest cavity.深面是胸膜顶和肺尖：只作浅斜刺，不可直刺深刺，不朝胸腔方向。

SI16 TiānchuāngSI16 天窗

Where is SI16 Tiānchuāng?天窗（SI16）在哪里？

On the lateral neck, level with the laryngeal prominence, at the posterior border of the sternocleidomastoid.颈部，横平喉结，胸锁乳突肌后缘。

How is SI16 needled?天窗（SI16）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of SI16?天窗（SI16）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Small Intestine channel手太阳小肠经穴

Main safety point at SI16?天窗（SI16）最要注意的安全问题？

The carotid sheath lies deep anteromedially: never needle toward it or over a pulse. Avoid the external jugular vein first; the cervical plexus branches surface here, so withdraw for shooting tingling.颈动脉鞘在前内侧深面：不向前内侧或搏动处进针；先避开颈外静脉，颈丛皮支在此浅出，窜麻即退针。

SI17 TiānróngSI17 天容

Where is SI17 Tiānróng?天容（SI17）在哪里？

On the neck, posterior to the angle of the mandible, in the depression at the anterior border of the sternocleidomastoid.颈部，下颌角后方，胸锁乳突肌前缘凹陷中。

How is SI17 needled?天容（SI17）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of SI17?天容（SI17）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Small Intestine channel手太阳小肠经穴

Main safety point at SI17?天容（SI17）最要注意的安全问题？

The internal jugular vein, internal carotid artery and hypoglossal and vagus nerves lie deep: palpate and avoid the pulse first, and never go deep anteromedially or lift-thrust.深面是颈内静脉、颈内动脉与舌下、迷走神经：先触诊避开搏动，不向前内侧深刺、不提插。

SI18 QuánliáoSI18 颧髎

Where is SI18 Quánliáo?颧髎（SI18）在哪里？

On the face, inferior to the zygomatic bone, directly below the outer canthus, in the depression.面部，颧骨下缘，目外眦直下凹陷中。

How is SI18 needled?颧髎（SI18）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, or oblique / transverse; Perpendicular 0.3–0.5 cun; oblique or transverse 0.5–1 cun.直刺，或斜刺、平刺；直刺 0.3–0.5 寸；斜刺或平刺 0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of SI18?颧髎（SI18）是哪类特定穴？

Meeting point of Hand-Shaoyang and Hand-Taiyang手少阳、手太阳交会穴

Main safety point at SI18?颧髎（SI18）最要注意的安全问题？

The face is vascular: press after withdrawal to prevent bruising, and do not angle deep upward toward the orbit.面部血管丰富，出针后按压防血肿；不向上朝眼眶方向深刺。

SI19 TīnggōngSI19 听宫

Where is SI19 Tīnggōng?听宫（SI19）在哪里？

On the face, in the depression between the middle of the tragus and the condylar process of the mandible.面部，耳屏正中与下颌骨髁突之间的凹陷中。

How is SI19 needled?听宫（SI19）怎么刺？

Mouth open, perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.张口，直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of SI19?听宫（SI19）是哪类特定穴？

Meeting point of Hand- and Foot-Shaoyang with Hand-Taiyang手足少阳、手太阳交会穴

Main safety point at SI19?听宫（SI19）最要注意的安全问题？

Insert with the mouth open and keep it open during retention, or the returning condyle squeezes the needle; avoid the superficial temporal pulse. Sudden hearing loss needs medical assessment first.必须张口进针、留针期间不闭口，否则髁突回位会挤压针身；避开颞浅动脉搏动。突发听力下降须先就医。

BL1 JīngmíngBL1 睛明

Where is BL1 Jīngmíng?睛明（BL1）在哪里？

At the medial canthus, slightly superior in the depression.目内眦稍上方凹陷处。

How is BL1 needled?睛明（BL1）怎么刺？

Slow perpendicular or oblique along the orbital wall; 0.5–1 cun.沿眶缘缓慢直刺或斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of BL1?睛明（BL1）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Bladder, Small Intestine, Stomach, Yin Qiao and Yang Qiao vessels手足太阳、足阳明、阴跷、阳跷五脉交会穴

Main safety point at BL1?睛明（BL1）最要注意的安全问题？

The globe, optic nerve, and orbital vessels are adjacent. Only specially trained clinicians should needle here; keep the tip along the orbital wall, never toward the globe.眼球、视神经和眶内血管紧邻；只限受过专门训练者操作，针尖始终沿眶缘，绝不向眼球方向。

BL2 CuánzhúBL2 攒竹

Where is BL2 Cuánzhú?攒竹（BL2）在哪里？

In the depression at the medial end of the eyebrow, near the supraorbital notch.眉头内侧端凹陷处，眶上切迹附近。

How is BL2 needled?攒竹（BL2）怎么刺？

Transverse laterally along the eyebrow; 0.3–0.5 cun.向外或向眉中平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at BL2?攒竹（BL2）最要注意的安全问题？

Supraorbital neurovascular structures and the orbit are adjacent; do not insert deeply downward into the orbit.眶上神经血管和眼眶邻近；不向下深刺入眶。

Where is BL3 Méichōng?眉冲（BL3）在哪里？

On the head, directly above the frontal notch, 0.5 cun within the anterior hairline (between GV24 and BL4).头部，额切迹直上入发际 0.5 寸（神庭与曲差之间）。

How is BL3 needled?眉冲（BL3）怎么刺？

Transverse in the scalp; 0.3–0.5 cun.沿头皮平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at BL3?眉冲（BL3）最要注意的安全问题？

The scalp is vascular; avoid visible vessels and do not insert deeply.头皮血管丰富，避开可见血管；不作深刺。

BL4 QūchāBL4 曲差

Where is BL4 Qūchā?曲差（BL4）在哪里？

Transverse in the scalp; 0.3–0.5 cun.沿头皮平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at BL4?曲差（BL4）最要注意的安全问题？

Insert only in the scalp plane and avoid superficial vessels.只在头皮层进针，避开表浅血管。

BL5 WǔchùBL5 五处

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Deep and medial lie the third part of the vertebral artery, the foramen magnum and medulla; never needle deeply upward-medially. Withdraw and seek care for severe pain, vertigo, nausea or limb numbness.深部内侧有椎动脉第三段与枕骨大孔、延髓；严禁向内上方深刺。针下出现剧痛、眩晕、恶心或肢体麻木立即出针并就医。

Pleura and lung are reachable deeply; the needle must travel shallowly toward the spine. Chest symptoms after needling require emergency care.深部可及胸膜和肺；针尖必须浅斜向脊柱。针后胸痛、气短、吸气痛或持续咳嗽须立即就医。

BL50 WeicangBL50 胃仓

Where is BL50 Weicang?胃仓（BL50）在哪里？

3 cun lateral to the posterior midline, level with the inferior border of the spinous process of T12.第 12 胸椎棘突下，后正中线旁开 3 寸。

How is BL50 needled?胃仓（BL50）怎么刺？

Oblique toward the spine; 0.5–0.8 cun.向脊柱方向斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at BL50?胃仓（BL50）最要注意的安全问题？

Pleura and lung are reachable deeply; the needle must travel shallowly toward the spine. Chest symptoms after needling require emergency care.深部可及胸膜和肺；针尖必须浅斜向脊柱。针后胸痛、气短、吸气痛或持续咳嗽须立即就医。

BL51 HuángménBL51 肓门

Where is BL51 Huángmén?肓门（BL51）在哪里？

Lumbar region, 3 cun lateral to the lower border of the L1 spinous process.腰区，第 1 腰椎棘突下，后正中线旁开 3 寸。

How is BL51 needled?肓门（BL51）怎么刺？

Oblique toward the spine; 0.5–0.8 cun.向脊柱方向斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at BL51?肓门（BL51）最要注意的安全问题？

The kidney lies deep: shallow oblique toward the spine only; no needling of the lower back in pregnancy. Severe flank pain or haematuria afterwards needs care.深部为肾，只浅斜向脊柱；孕妇腰部不针。针后腰侧剧痛或血尿立即就医。

BL52 ZhìshìBL52 志室

Where is BL52 Zhìshì?志室（BL52）在哪里？

Lumbar region, 3 cun lateral to the lower border of the L2 spinous process.腰区，第 2 腰椎棘突下，后正中线旁开 3 寸。

How is BL52 needled?志室（BL52）怎么刺？

Oblique toward the spine; 0.5–0.8 cun.向脊柱方向斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at BL52?志室（BL52）最要注意的安全问题？

The kidney lies deep: shallow oblique toward the spine only; no needling of the lower back in pregnancy. Severe flank pain or haematuria afterwards needs care.深部为肾，只浅斜向脊柱；孕妇腰部不针。针后腰侧剧痛或血尿立即就医。

BL53 BāohuāngBL53 胞肓

Where is BL53 Bāohuāng?胞肓（BL53）在哪里？

Sacral region, level with the 2nd posterior sacral foramen, 3 cun lateral to the median sacral crest.骶区，横平第 2 骶后孔，骶正中嵴旁开 3 寸。

How is BL53 needled?胞肓（BL53）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Main safety point at BL53?胞肓（BL53）最要注意的安全问题？

Superior gluteal vessels and nerve lie deep; withdraw at electric radiation. No sacral needling in pregnancy.深部有臀上血管神经；出现放射麻电感即退针。孕妇骶部不针。

BL54 ZhìbiānBL54 秩边

Where is BL54 Zhìbiān?秩边（BL54）在哪里？

Sacral region, level with the 4th posterior sacral foramen, 3 cun lateral to the median sacral crest.骶区，横平第 4 骶后孔，骶正中嵴旁开 3 寸。

How is BL54 needled?秩边（BL54）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1.5–2 cun.直刺；1.5–2 寸。

Main safety point at BL54?秩边（BL54）最要注意的安全问题？

The sciatic nerve and inferior gluteal vessels lie deep; repeated strong stimulation can injure the nerve. Persistent numbness or foot weakness afterwards needs assessment. No sacral needling in pregnancy.深部为坐骨神经与臀下血管；反复强刺可致神经损伤。针后持续麻木、足无力需评估。孕妇骶部不针。

BL55 HéyángBL55 合阳

Where is BL55 Héyáng?合阳（BL55）在哪里？

Posterior leg, 2 cun below the popliteal crease, between the medial and lateral heads of gastrocnemius.小腿后区，腘横纹下 2 寸，腓肠肌内、外侧头之间。

How is BL55 needled?合阳（BL55）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–2 cun.直刺；1–2 寸。

Main safety point at BL55?合阳（BL55）最要注意的安全问题？

The tibial nerve and popliteal vessels lie deep; control depth and stop for electric radiation or bleeding.深部为胫神经与腘动静脉；控制深度，出现放射电击感或明显出血即停止。

BL56 ChéngjīnBL56 承筋

Where is BL56 Chéngjīn?承筋（BL56）在哪里？

Posterior leg, 5 cun below the popliteal crease, between the two muscle bellies of gastrocnemius.小腿后区，腘横纹下 5 寸，腓肠肌两肌腹之间。

How is BL56 needled?承筋（BL56）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Main safety point at BL56?承筋（BL56）最要注意的安全问题？

Tibial nerve and posterior tibial vessels lie deep; withdraw at electric radiation. A suddenly swollen hot calf needs a thrombosis check first — no needling or massage.深部为胫神经和胫后血管；放射麻电感即退针。单侧小腿突发肿热痛先排除静脉血栓，不针不按。

BL57 ChéngshānBL57 承山

Where is BL57 Chéngshān?承山（BL57）在哪里？

Posterior leg, at the angle where the two gastrocnemius bellies meet the tendon.小腿后区，腓肠肌两肌腹与肌腱交角处。

How is BL57 needled?承山（BL57）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–2 cun.直刺；1–2 寸。

Main safety point at BL57?承山（BL57）最要注意的安全问题？

Tibial nerve and posterior tibial vessels deep; withdraw at electric radiation. A suddenly swollen hot calf needs a thrombosis check first.深部为胫神经与胫后血管；放射麻电感即退针。单侧小腿突发肿热痛先排除静脉血栓。

BL58 FēiyángBL58 飞扬

Where is BL58 Fēiyáng?飞扬（BL58）在哪里？

Posterior leg, 7 cun directly above BL60, where the lower lateral border of gastrocnemius meets the calcaneal tendon.小腿后区，昆仑直上 7 寸，腓肠肌外下缘与跟腱移行处。

How is BL58 needled?飞扬（BL58）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of BL58?飞扬（BL58）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point络穴

Main safety point at BL58?飞扬（BL58）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid a visible small saphenous vein; generally safe.浅层小隐静脉可见时避开；一般安全。

BL59 FūyángBL59 跗阳

Where is BL59 Fūyáng?跗阳（BL59）在哪里？

Posterior leg, 3 cun directly above BL60, between the fibula and the calcaneal tendon.小腿后区，昆仑直上 3 寸，腓骨与跟腱之间。

How is BL59 needled?跗阳（BL59）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.8–1.2 cun.直刺；0.8–1.2 寸。

Special-point roles of BL59?跗阳（BL59）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point of the Yang Qiao vessel阳跷脉郄穴

Main safety point at BL59?跗阳（BL59）最要注意的安全问题？

Sural nerve and small saphenous vein run superficially; redirect at tingling to the lateral foot.腓肠神经与小隐静脉浅行；出现足外侧放射麻感即调整。

BL60 KūnlúnBL60 昆仑

Where is BL60 Kūnlún?昆仑（BL60）在哪里？

Ankle region, in the depression between the prominence of the lateral malleolus and the calcaneal tendon.踝区，外踝尖与跟腱之间的凹陷中。

How is BL60 needled?昆仑（BL60）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of BL60?昆仑（BL60）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river point (fire)经穴（火）

Main safety point at BL60?昆仑（BL60）最要注意的安全问题？

Contraindicated in pregnancy (classically used for difficult labour). Sural nerve and small saphenous vein are superficial; avoid visible vessels.孕妇禁针（古籍主滞产、难产）。浅层腓肠神经与小隐静脉，避开可见血管。

BL61 PúcānBL61 仆参

Where is BL61 Púcān?仆参（BL61）在哪里？

Heel region, directly below BL60, lateral side of the calcaneus, at the border of the red and white skin.跟区，昆仑直下，跟骨外侧，赤白肉际处。

How is BL61 needled?仆参（BL61）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at BL61?仆参（BL61）最要注意的安全问题？

Thin skin over bone: shallow insertion; not over inflamed or broken skin.皮薄贴骨，浅刺；局部红肿破溃不针。

BL62 ShēnmàiBL62 申脉

Where is BL62 Shēnmài?申脉（BL62）在哪里？

Ankle region, directly below the tip of the lateral malleolus, in the depression between its lower border and the calcaneus.踝区，外踝尖直下，外踝下缘与跟骨之间凹陷中。

How is BL62 needled?申脉（BL62）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of BL62?申脉（BL62）是哪类特定穴？

Confluent point of the eight extraordinary vessels (Yang Qiao)八脉交会穴（通阳跷脉）

Main safety point at BL62?申脉（BL62）最要注意的安全问题？

Superficial nerve twigs and tendons; avoid forceful deep insertion onto bone.浅层神经末支与肌腱；不强压深刺骨面。

BL63 JīnménBL63 金门

Where is BL63 Jīnmén?金门（BL63）在哪里？

Dorsum of the foot, directly below the anterior border of the lateral malleolus, posterior to the 5th metatarsal tuberosity, in the depression below the cuboid.足背，外踝前缘直下，第 5 跖骨粗隆后方，骰骨下缘凹陷中。

How is BL63 needled?金门（BL63）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of BL63?金门（BL63）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point郄穴

Main safety point at BL63?金门（BL63）最要注意的安全问题？

Superficial nerves and small vessels; not over swelling or broken skin.浅层神经与小血管；局部肿胀破溃不针。

BL64 JīnggǔBL64 京骨

Where is BL64 Jīnggǔ?京骨（BL64）在哪里？

Metatarsal region, anteroinferior to the 5th metatarsal tuberosity, at the border of the red and white skin.跖区，第 5 跖骨粗隆前下方，赤白肉际处。

How is BL64 needled?京骨（BL64）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of BL64?京骨（BL64）是哪类特定穴？

Yuan-source point原穴

Main safety point at BL64?京骨（BL64）最要注意的安全问题？

Thin skin near bone; insert shallowly.皮薄近骨，浅刺。

BL65 ShùgǔBL65 束骨

Where is BL65 Shùgǔ?束骨（BL65）在哪里？

Metatarsal region, proximal to the 5th metatarsophalangeal joint, at the border of the red and white skin.跖区，第 5 跖趾关节的近端，赤白肉际处。

How is BL65 needled?束骨（BL65）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of BL65?束骨（BL65）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream point (wood)输穴（木）

Main safety point at BL65?束骨（BL65）最要注意的安全问题？

Thin skin near the joint; shallow. A red hot swollen joint needs a gout or infection check first.皮薄近关节，浅刺；关节红肿热痛先查痛风或感染。

BL66 ZútōnggǔBL66 足通谷

Where is BL66 Zútōnggǔ?足通谷（BL66）在哪里？

Toe region, distal to the 5th metatarsophalangeal joint, at the border of the red and white skin.足趾，第 5 跖趾关节的远端，赤白肉际处。

How is BL66 needled?足通谷（BL66）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.2–0.3 cun.直刺；0.2–0.3 寸。

Special-point roles of BL66?足通谷（BL66）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring point (water)荥穴（水）

Main safety point at BL66?足通谷（BL66）最要注意的安全问题？

Thin skin: shallow; not over broken skin or a diabetic foot.皮薄，浅刺；趾间破溃、糖尿病足不针。

BL67 ZhìyīnBL67 至阴

Where is BL67 Zhìyīn?至阴（BL67）在哪里？

Toe region, lateral side of the distal phalanx of the little toe, 0.1 finger-cun proximal-lateral to the corner of the toenail.足趾，小趾末节外侧，趾甲根角侧后方 0.1 寸（指寸）。

How is BL67 needled?至阴（BL67）怎么刺？

Shallow insertion; 0.1 cun.浅刺；0.1 寸。

Special-point roles of BL67?至阴（BL67）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well point (metal)井穴（金）

Main safety point at BL67?至阴（BL67）最要注意的安全问题？

Correct malposition with moxibustion only, never needling, after obstetric confirmation and exclusion of placenta praevia, pelvic contraction and the like, with follow-up. Not over paronychia or ulcers.纠正胎位只用灸，不针；须产科确认胎位、排除前置胎盘、骨盆狭窄等后在随访下进行。甲沟炎、溃疡处不刺。

KI1 YǒngquánKI1 涌泉

Where is KI1 Yǒngquán?涌泉（KI1）在哪里？

On the sole, in the deepest depression of the sole when the toes are curled.足底，屈足卷趾时足心最凹陷中。

How is KI1 needled?涌泉（KI1）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of KI1?涌泉（KI1）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well (wood)井穴（木）

Main safety point at KI1?涌泉（KI1）最要注意的安全问题？

The sole is very sensitive and the plantar arterial arch and nerve branches lie deep: do not insert deeply blind, withdraw for an electric-shock sensation, and do not needle diabetic-foot, infected or broken skin.足底痛觉敏感，深层有足底动脉弓和神经分支：不盲目深刺，出现电击样麻感即退针；糖尿病足、感染或破损皮肤处不针。

KI2 RángǔKI2 然谷

Where is KI2 Rángǔ?然谷（KI2）在哪里？

On the medial foot, below the tuberosity of the navicular bone, at the border of the red and white skin.足内侧，足舟骨粗隆下方，赤白肉际处。

How is KI2 needled?然谷（KI2）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of KI2?然谷（KI2）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring (fire)荥穴（火）

Main safety point at KI2?然谷（KI2）最要注意的安全问题？

Bone is not far down; avoid superficial veins. The Jiayi Jing warns against drawing much blood, so press after withdrawal; withdraw for electric tingling into the sole.骨面不深，避开浅静脉；《甲乙经》说「刺无多见血」，出针按压；有向足底放射的电麻感即退针。

KI3 TàixīKI3 太溪

Where is KI3 Tàixī?太溪（KI3）在哪里？

In the ankle region, in the depression between the tip of the medial malleolus and the calcaneal tendon.踝区，内踝尖与跟腱之间的凹陷中。

How is KI3 needled?太溪（KI3）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of KI3?太溪（KI3）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream (earth), Yuan-source point输穴（土）、原穴

Main safety point at KI3?太溪（KI3）最要注意的安全问题？

The posterior tibial artery and tibial nerve run deep through the tarsal tunnel: feel the pulse and avoid it, no repeated deep lifting-thrusting, and withdraw at once for electric tingling into the sole.胫后动脉、胫神经在深面经过踝管：先摸搏动并避开，不向深处反复提插；出现向足底放射的电麻感立即退针。

KI4 DàzhōngKI4 大钟

Where is KI4 Dàzhōng?大钟（KI4）在哪里？

In the heel region, posteroinferior to the medial malleolus, superior to the calcaneus, in the depression anterior to the attachment of the calcaneal tendon.跟区，内踝后下方，跟骨上缘，跟腱附着部前缘凹陷中。

How is KI4 needled?大钟（KI4）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of KI4?大钟（KI4）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point络穴

Main safety point at KI4?大钟（KI4）最要注意的安全问题？

The tendon insertion and calcaneus are shallow: insert shallowly, not into the tendon, and do not probe deep anteriorly toward the posterior tibial branches.跟腱止点和跟骨都很浅：浅刺，不刺入跟腱，不向前方深处探针（胫后血管神经分支）。

KI5 ShuǐquánKI5 水泉

Where is KI5 Shuǐquán?水泉（KI5）在哪里？

In the heel region, 1 cun directly below KI3, in the depression on the medial side of the calcaneal tuberosity.跟区，太溪直下 1 寸，跟骨结节内侧凹陷中。

How is KI5 needled?水泉（KI5）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of KI5?水泉（KI5）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point郄穴

Main safety point at KI5?水泉（KI5）最要注意的安全问题？

Bone is very shallow: insert shallowly without striking the periosteum; do not needle cracked, callused or infected heel skin.骨面很浅：浅刺，不顶撞骨膜；足跟皲裂、胼胝或感染处不针。

KI6 ZhàohǎiKI6 照海

Where is KI6 Zhàohǎi?照海（KI6）在哪里？

In the ankle region, 1 cun below the tip of the medial malleolus, in the depression at the lower border of the malleolus.踝区，内踝尖下 1 寸，内踝下缘边际凹陷中。

How is KI6 needled?照海（KI6）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of KI6?照海（KI6）是哪类特定穴？

Eight-confluent point (opens the Yin Qiao vessel)八脉交会穴（通阴跷脉）

Main safety point at KI6?照海（KI6）最要注意的安全问题？

Bone and ligament are close: do not probe into the ankle joint; angling posteroinferiorly approaches the posterior tibial vessels and tibial nerve, so withdraw for electric tingling.骨面与韧带很近：不向踝关节深处探刺；针尖偏后下方会接近胫后血管与胫神经，有电麻感即退针。

KI7 FùliūKI7 复溜

Where is KI7 Fùliū?复溜（KI7）在哪里？

On the medial lower leg, 2 cun above the tip of the medial malleolus, at the anterior border of the calcaneal tendon.小腿内侧，内踝尖上 2 寸，跟腱的前缘。

How is KI7 needled?复溜（KI7）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of KI7?复溜（KI7）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river (metal)经穴（金）

Main safety point at KI7?复溜（KI7）最要注意的安全问题？

Do not insert into the tendon or advance deep and anteromedially toward the posterior tibial bundle; withdraw at once for electric tingling into the sole.不刺入跟腱；不向深部前内侧推进（胫后血管神经束）；出现沿足底放射的电麻感立即退针。

KI8 JiāoxìnKI8 交信

Where is KI8 Jiāoxìn?交信（KI8）在哪里？

On the medial lower leg, 2 cun above the tip of the medial malleolus, in the depression posterior to the medial border of the tibia.小腿内侧，内踝尖上 2 寸，胫骨内侧缘后际凹陷中。

How is KI8 needled?交信（KI8）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of KI8?交信（KI8）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point of the Yin Qiao vessel阴跷脉郄穴

Main safety point at KI8?交信（KI8）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid the visible great saphenous vein; do not insert deep posteriorly toward the posterior tibial bundle.避开皮下可见的大隐静脉；不向后方深刺（胫后血管神经束）。

KI9 ZhùbīnKI9 筑宾

Where is KI9 Zhùbīn?筑宾（KI9）在哪里？

On the medial lower leg, 5 cun directly above KI3, between soleus and the calcaneal tendon.小腿内侧，太溪直上 5 寸，比目鱼肌与跟腱之间。

How is KI9 needled?筑宾（KI9）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of KI9?筑宾（KI9）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point of the Yin Wei vessel阴维脉郄穴

How is PC4 needled?郄门（PC4）怎么刺？
