Special-point roles of PC4?郄门（PC4）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point郄穴

Main safety point at PC4?郄门（PC4）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins; withdraw and redirect for radiating median-nerve paresthesia.避开浅静脉；出现正中神经放射样麻感应退针调整。

PC5 JiānshǐPC5 间使

Where is PC5 Jiānshǐ?间使（PC5）在哪里？

Anterior forearm, 3 cun above the wrist crease, between palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis tendons.前臂前面，腕横纹上3寸，掌长肌腱与桡侧腕屈肌腱之间。

How is PC5 needled?间使（PC5）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of PC5?间使（PC5）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river point, metal经穴，属金

Main safety point at PC5?间使（PC5）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins; withdraw for electric paresthesia and do not repeatedly manipulate toward the median nerve.避开浅静脉；有电击样麻感时退针，不在正中神经方向反复操作。

PC6 NèiguānPC6 内关

Where is PC6 Nèiguān?内关（PC6）在哪里？

Anterior forearm, 2 cun above the wrist crease, between palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis tendons.前臂前面，腕横纹上2寸，掌长肌腱与桡侧腕屈肌腱之间。

How is PC6 needled?内关（PC6）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of PC6?内关（PC6）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point; Eight-confluent point, opens the Yin Wei vessel络穴；八脉交会穴，通阴维脉

Main safety point at PC6?内关（PC6）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins; immediately withdraw and redirect for paresthesia radiating to the fingers.避开浅静脉；出现向手指放射的麻感应立即退针调整。

PC7 DàlíngPC7 大陵

Where is PC7 Dàlíng?大陵（PC7）在哪里？

Anterior wrist, at the centre of the wrist crease, between palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis tendons.腕前区，腕横纹中央，掌长肌腱与桡侧腕屈肌腱之间。

How is PC7 needled?大陵（PC7）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5寸。

Special-point roles of PC7?大陵（PC7）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream and yuan-source point, earth输穴、原穴，属土

Main safety point at PC7?大陵（PC7）最要注意的安全问题？

The point lies over the entrance of the carpal tunnel where the median nerve is most superficial: shallow insertion of 0.3–0.5 cun only, no deep insertion or lifting-thrusting, and withdraw at an electric tingle.穴位就在腕管入口上方，正中神经在此最浅：只浅刺 0.3–0.5 寸，不深刺、不提插，针下电麻即退针。

PC8 LáogōngPC8 劳宫

Where is PC8 Láogōng?劳宫（PC8）在哪里？

Centre of palm, between the 2nd and 3rd metacarpals nearer the 3rd; where the middle fingertip falls in a fist.掌心，第2、3掌骨之间偏第3掌骨，握拳时中指尖所指处。

How is PC8 needled?劳宫（PC8）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5寸。

Special-point roles of PC8?劳宫（PC8）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring point, fire荥穴，属火

Main safety point at PC8?劳宫（PC8）最要注意的安全问题？

Palmar vessels and nerves are dense; avoid visible vessels and do not needle deeply to the palmar arch.掌部血管神经密集，避开可见血管；不可深刺至掌弓。

PC9 ZhōngchōngPC9 中冲

Where is PC9 Zhōngchōng?中冲（PC9）在哪里？

Centre of the tip of the middle finger.中指尖端中央。

How is PC9 needled?中冲（PC9）怎么刺？

Superficial 0.1 cun or prick to bleed; 0.1 cun.浅刺0.1寸或点刺出血；0.1寸。

Special-point roles of PC9?中冲（PC9）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well point, wood井穴，属木

Main safety point at PC9?中冲（PC9）最要注意的安全问题？

Use only superficial or pricking technique; avoid deep insertion, repeated squeezing, and infection risk.仅作浅刺或点刺，避免深刺、反复挤压和感染风险。

TE1 GuānchōngTE1 关冲

Where is TE1 Guānchōng?关冲（TE1）在哪里？

On the ulnar side of the ring finger, about 0.1 cun from the nail corner.无名指尺侧，距指甲角约0.1寸。

How is TE1 needled?关冲（TE1）怎么刺？

Superficial 0.1 cun or prick to bleed; 0.1 cun.浅刺0.1寸或点刺出血；0.1寸。

Special-point roles of TE1?关冲（TE1）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well point, metal井穴，属金

Main safety point at TE1?关冲（TE1）最要注意的安全问题？

Use only superficial or pricking technique, with asepsis and without repeated squeezing.仅浅刺或点刺，注意无菌并避免反复挤压。

TE2 YèménTE2 液门

Where is TE2 Yèmén?液门（TE2）在哪里？

Dorsum of hand, between the 4th and 5th fingers, just proximal to the web margin at the border of dorsal and palmar skin.手背，第4、5指缝间，指蹼缘后方赤白肉际处。

How is TE2 needled?液门（TE2）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique proximally; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺或向近端斜刺；0.3–0.5寸。

Special-point roles of TE2?液门（TE2）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring point, water荥穴，属水

Main safety point at TE2?液门（TE2）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid dorsal veins and the dorsal branch of ulnar nerve; withdraw if marked paresthesia occurs.避开手背静脉及尺神经手背支；麻感明显应退针。

TE3 ZhōngzhǔTE3 中渚

Where is TE3 Zhōngzhǔ?中渚（TE3）在哪里？

Dorsum of hand, between the 4th and 5th metacarpals, in the hollow proximal to the 4th metacarpophalangeal joint.手背，第4、5掌骨间，第4掌指关节近端凹陷中。

How is TE3 needled?中渚（TE3）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5寸。

Special-point roles of TE3?中渚（TE3）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream point, wood输穴，属木

Main safety point at TE3?中渚（TE3）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid dorsal veins and dorsal ulnar nerve; do not needle deeply toward the palm.避开手背静脉和尺神经手背支；不可向掌侧深刺。

TE4 YángchíTE4 阳池

Where is TE4 Yángchí?阳池（TE4）在哪里？

Centre of dorsal wrist crease, in the hollow ulnar to the common extensor tendon.腕背横纹中央，指总伸肌腱尺侧凹陷中。

How is TE4 needled?阳池（TE4）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5寸。

Special-point roles of TE4?阳池（TE4）是哪类特定穴？

Yuan-source point原穴

Main safety point at TE4?阳池（TE4）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid dorsal veins and cutaneous nerve branches; stop at bone and do not force a deep insertion.避开手背静脉和皮神经支；遇骨即止，不可强行深刺。

TE5 WàiguānTE5 外关

Where is TE5 Wàiguān?外关（TE5）在哪里？

Posterior forearm, 2 cun above the dorsal wrist crease, between ulna and radius.前臂后面，腕背横纹上2寸，尺骨与桡骨之间。

How is TE5 needled?外关（TE5）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of TE5?外关（TE5）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point; Eight-confluent point, opens the Yang Wei vessel络穴；八脉交会穴，通阳维脉

Main safety point at TE5?外关（TE5）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins; withdraw and redirect for marked radiating sensation or extensor weakness.避开浅静脉；出现伸指无力或明显放射感应退针调整。

TE6 ZhīgōuTE6 支沟

Where is TE6 Zhīgōu?支沟（TE6）在哪里？

Posterior forearm, 3 cun above the dorsal wrist crease, between ulna and radius.前臂后面，腕背横纹上3寸，尺骨与桡骨之间。

How is TE6 needled?支沟（TE6）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–1 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of TE6?支沟（TE6）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river point, fire经穴，属火

Main safety point at TE6?支沟（TE6）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins; deep insertion requires caution around posterior interosseous nerve, with withdrawal for abnormal paresthesia.避开浅静脉；深刺应警惕骨间后神经，出现异常麻感退针。

TE7 HuìzōngTE7 会宗

Where is TE7 Huìzōng?会宗（TE7）在哪里？

Posterior forearm, 3 cun above the dorsal wrist crease, on the radial border of the ulna.前臂后面，腕背横纹上3寸，尺骨桡侧缘。

How is TE7 needled?会宗（TE7）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of TE7?会宗（TE7）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point郄穴

Main safety point at TE7?会宗（TE7）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins; do not force beyond bone and withdraw for abnormal paresthesia.避开浅静脉；抵骨后勿强行进针，异常麻感应退针。

TE8 SānyángluòTE8 三阳络

Where is TE8 Sānyángluò?三阳络（TE8）在哪里？

Posterior forearm, 4 cun above the dorsal wrist crease, between ulna and radius.前臂后面，腕背横纹上4寸，尺骨与桡骨之间。

How is TE8 needled?三阳络（TE8）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of TE8?三阳络（TE8）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Triple Energizer channel手少阳三焦经穴

Main safety point at TE8?三阳络（TE8）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins; withdraw and redirect if deep nerve stimulation causes paresthesia.避开浅静脉；深部神经受刺激出现麻感时退针调整。

TE9 SìdúTE9 四渎

Where is TE9 Sìdú?四渎（TE9）在哪里？

Posterior forearm, 5 cun below the olecranon, between ulna and radius.前臂后面，肘尖下5寸，尺骨与桡骨之间。

How is TE9 needled?四渎（TE9）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of TE9?四渎（TE9）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Triple Energizer channel手少阳三焦经穴

Main safety point at TE9?四渎（TE9）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins; avoid repeated deep stimulation toward the posterior interosseous nerve.避开浅静脉；深刺避免向骨间后神经反复刺激。

TE10 TiānjǐngTE10 天井

Where is TE10 Tiānjǐng?天井（TE10）在哪里？

Posterior elbow, in the hollow 1 cun superior to the olecranon when the elbow is flexed.肘后区，屈肘时肘尖上1寸凹陷中。

How is TE10 needled?天井（TE10）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of TE10?天井（TE10）是哪类特定穴？

He-sea point, earth合穴，属土

Main safety point at TE10?天井（TE10）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid the course of the ulnar nerve; do not probe deeply posteromedially, and stop at bone or capsular resistance.避开尺神经走行方向，勿向内侧后方深探；遇骨或关节囊阻力即止。

TE11 QīnglěngyuānTE11 清冷渊

Where is TE11 Qīnglěngyuān?清冷渊（TE11）在哪里？

Posterior upper arm, on the line connecting the olecranon and the acromial angle, 2 cun superior to the olecranon.臂后区，肘尖与肩峰角连线上，肘尖上2寸。

How is TE11 needled?清冷渊（TE11）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of TE11?清冷渊（TE11）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Triple Energizer channel手少阳三焦经穴

Main safety point at TE11?清冷渊（TE11）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins; deep insertion must account for radial nerve and profunda brachii vessels, with withdrawal for radiating paresthesia.避开浅静脉；深刺要顾及桡神经和肱深血管，放射样麻感应退针。

TE12 XiāoluòTE12 消泺

Where is TE12 Xiāoluò?消泺（TE12）在哪里？

Posterior upper arm, on the line from olecranon to acromion, 5 cun above the olecranon.上臂后面，肘尖与肩峰连线上，肘尖上5寸。

How is TE12 needled?消泺（TE12）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of TE12?消泺（TE12）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Triple Energizer channel手少阳三焦经穴

Main safety point at TE12?消泺（TE12）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial veins; deep insertion requires caution around radial nerve and profunda brachii vessels, and radiating sensation requires immediate withdrawal.避开浅静脉；深刺须警惕桡神经和肱深血管，出现放射感立即退针。

TE13 NàohuìTE13 臑会

Where is TE13 Nàohuì?臑会（TE13）在哪里？

On the posterior upper arm, 3 cun inferior to the acromial angle, at the posteroinferior border of the deltoid.臂后区，肩峰角下 3 寸，三角肌后下缘。

How is TE13 needled?臑会（TE13）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of TE13?臑会（TE13）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Triple Energizer channel手少阳三焦经穴

Main safety point at TE13?臑会（TE13）最要注意的安全问题？

The radial nerve and profunda brachii vessels may be reached deeply; withdraw and redirect for radiating paresthesia, and avoid visible superficial veins.深层可能接近桡神经和肱深血管；有放射样麻感应退针调整，避免穿刺可见浅静脉。

TE14 JiānjiáoTE14 肩髎

Where is TE14 Jiānjiáo?肩髎（TE14）在哪里？

Shoulder, in the depression between the acromial angle and greater tubercle of humerus.肩部，肩峰角与肱骨大结节两骨之间凹陷中。

How is TE14 needled?肩髎（TE14）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, toward the shoulder joint; 1–1.5 cun.直刺，针尖向肩关节；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of TE14?肩髎（TE14）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Triple Energizer channel手少阳三焦经穴

Main safety point at TE14?肩髎（TE14）最要注意的安全问题？

The axillary nerve and posterior circumflex humeral vessels are deep; do not blindly needle deeply or posteromedially, and withdraw for radiating paresthesia.深部有腋神经和旋肱后血管，勿盲目深刺或向后内方探刺；放射麻感应退针调整。

TE15 TiānliáoTE15 天髎

Where is TE15 Tiānliáo?天髎（TE15）在哪里？

Suprascapular region, in the depression at the superior angle of scapula; with shoulders relaxed, midway between GB21 and SI13.肩胛上区，肩胛骨上角骨际凹陷中；正坐垂肩时，在肩井（GB21）与曲垣（SI13）连线中点。

How is TE15 needled?天髎（TE15）怎么刺？

Oblique inferolaterally along the scapular surface; 0.5–0.8 cun.向外下方斜刺，沿肩胛骨面；0.5–0.8寸。

Special-point roles of TE15?天髎（TE15）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Triple Energizer, Gallbladder, and Yang Wei vessel手少阳、足少阳、阳维脉交会穴

Main safety point at TE15?天髎（TE15）最要注意的安全问题？

The pleural apex and lung can lie inferomedially. Needle only inferolaterally along the scapular surface, never deeply inferomedially. Chest pain, shortness of breath, or pain on breathing after needling is an emergency: get care now (911 in BC).内下方深面可能到达胸膜顶和肺；仅可沿肩胛骨面向外下斜刺，绝不可向内下深刺。针后胸痛、气短或吸气痛为急症，立即就医（BC拨911）。

TE16 TiānyǒuTE16 天牖

Where is TE16 Tiānyǒu?天牖（TE16）在哪里？

On the neck, level with the angle of the mandible, in the hollow at the posterior border of sternocleidomastoid.颈部，横平下颌角，胸锁乳突肌后缘凹陷中。

How is TE16 needled?天牖（TE16）怎么刺？

Oblique posterolaterally; 0.5–0.8 cun.向后外方斜刺；0.5–0.8寸。

Special-point roles of TE16?天牖（TE16）是哪类特定穴？

One of the 'five regions of Tianyou' (Lingshu, Benshu)「天牖五部」之一（《灵枢·本输》）

Main safety point at TE16?天牖（TE16）最要注意的安全问题？

The carotid sheath is anteromedial, with external jugular vein and accessory nerve nearby; never needle deeply anteromedially or through a palpable pulse.颈动脉鞘在前内侧，另有颈外静脉和副神经；不可向前内侧深刺，不可在搏动处进针。

TE17 YìfēngTE17 翳风

Where is TE17 Yìfēng?翳风（TE17）在哪里？

Neck, in the hollow posterior to the earlobe and anterior to the lower end of mastoid process.颈部，耳垂后方、乳突下端前方凹陷中。

How is TE17 needled?翳风（TE17）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or slightly oblique anterosuperiorly; 0.5–1 cun.直刺或微向前上方斜刺；0.5–1寸。

Special-point roles of TE17?翳风（TE17）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Triple Energizer and Gallbladder channels手少阳、足少阳交会穴

Main safety point at TE17?翳风（TE17）最要注意的安全问题？

The parotid, facial nerve, and external carotid-related structures lie deep; do not blindly needle deeply or repeatedly stimulate strongly, and avoid visible vessels.深面是腮腺与面神经、颈外动脉相关结构；不可盲目深刺或反复强刺激，避开可见血管。

TE18 ChìmàiTE18 瘈脉

Where is TE18 Chìmài?瘈脉（TE18）在哪里？

Head, at the centre of mastoid region, on the curved line along the ear helix: at the junction of upper two-thirds and lower third from TE20 to TE17.头部，乳突中央，沿耳轮弧形连线，在角孙（TE20）与翳风（TE17）连线的上2/3与下1/3交点。

How is TE18 needled?瘈脉（TE18）怎么刺？

Transverse or oblique; 0.3–0.5 cun.平刺或斜刺；0.3–0.5寸。

Special-point roles of TE18?瘈脉（TE18）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Triple Energizer channel手少阳三焦经穴

Main safety point at TE18?瘈脉（TE18）最要注意的安全问题？

Postauricular vessels and sensory nerves are superficial; avoid visible vessels and do not probe deeply toward mastoid.耳后血管和感觉神经表浅，避开可见血管；不可向乳突深探。

TE19 LúxīTE19 颅息

Where is TE19 Lúxī?颅息（TE19）在哪里？

Head, on the curved line along the ear helix: at the junction of upper third and lower two-thirds from TE20 to TE17.头部，沿耳轮弧形连线，在角孙（TE20）与翳风（TE17）连线的上1/3与下2/3交点。

How is TE19 needled?颅息（TE19）怎么刺？

Transverse or oblique; 0.3–0.5 cun.平刺或斜刺；0.3–0.5寸。

Special-point roles of TE19?颅息（TE19）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Triple Energizer channel手少阳三焦经穴

Main safety point at TE19?颅息（TE19）最要注意的安全问题？

Scalp vessels and nerves are superficial; avoid visible vessels, stop at bone, and do not needle deeply.头皮血管神经表浅，避开可见血管；抵骨即止，不作深刺。

TE20 JiǎosūnTE20 角孙

Where is TE20 Jiǎosūn?角孙（TE20）在哪里？

Head, at the hairline directly above the apex of the auricle.头部，耳尖正对发际处。

How is TE20 needled?角孙（TE20）怎么刺？

Transverse; 0.3–0.5 cun.平刺；0.3–0.5寸。

Special-point roles of TE20?角孙（TE20）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Triple Energizer and Gallbladder channels手少阳、足少阳交会穴

Main safety point at TE20?角孙（TE20）最要注意的安全问题？

Superficial temporal vessels are superficial: avoid a pulse and visible vessels, needle only along the scalp, and do not needle deeply.颞浅血管表浅，先避开搏动和可见血管；仅沿头皮平刺，不可深刺。

TE21 ĚrménTE21 耳门

Where is TE21 Ěrmén?耳门（TE21）在哪里？

Face, in the depression anterior to the supratragic notch and posterior to the mandibular condyle; locate with mouth open.面部，耳屏上切迹前方、下颌骨髁突后缘的凹陷中；张口时取穴。

How is TE21 needled?耳门（TE21）怎么刺？

Mouth slightly open, perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.微张口，直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of TE21?耳门（TE21）是哪类特定穴？

Point of the Triple Energizer channel手少阳三焦经穴

Main safety point at TE21?耳门（TE21）最要注意的安全问题？

Near superficial temporal vessels, auriculotemporal nerve, TMJ, and parotid; locate with mouth open, avoid a pulse, and do not needle deeply.邻近颞浅血管、耳颞神经、颞下颌关节和腮腺；张口定位，避开搏动，勿深刺。

Main safety point at TE23?丝竹空（TE23）最要注意的安全问题？

This point lies next to the orbit and direction of the globe; needle only along the eyebrow, never into the orbit, downward, or deeply. Visual change, persistent eye pain, or rapidly increasing periorbital swelling needs emergency assessment now.紧邻眼眶和眼球方向；只沿眉弓平刺，绝不可向眶内、向下或深刺。出现视力改变、持续眼痛或眼周迅速肿胀应立即急诊评估。

GB21 JiānjǐngGB21 肩井

Contraindicated in pregnancy (classically used for difficult labour).气胸高危：提起斜方肌，针不向前下方（锁骨上窝、胸膜顶）深刺；针后胸痛、气短、干咳要按气胸处理。孕妇禁针（古籍主难产）。

Thin chest wall with pleura and lung beneath: thread along the space only, never perpendicular or deep. The Jiayi Jing forbids moxibustion here.胸壁薄、深面即胸膜和肺：只沿肋间隙平刺，不直刺、不深刺。《甲乙经》载本穴不可灸。

GB23 ZhéjīnGB23 辄筋

On the lateral chest, in the 4th intercostal space, 1 cun anterior to the mid-axillary line.胸外侧区，第 4 肋间隙中，腋中线前 1 寸。

How is GB23 needled?辄筋（GB23）怎么刺？

Transverse or oblique along the intercostal space; 0.5–0.8 cun.沿肋间隙平刺或斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at GB23?辄筋（GB23）最要注意的安全问题？

As GB22: pleura and lung beneath, thread only; one cun forward the wall is still thin, especially in lean people.同渊腋：深面胸膜与肺，只沿肋间平刺；偏前一寸胸壁仍薄，消瘦者尤甚。

GB24 RìyuèGB24 日月

Where is GB24 Rìyuè?日月（GB24）在哪里？

On the chest, in the 7th intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，第 7 肋间隙中，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is GB24 needled?日月（GB24）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse; 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或平刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of GB24?日月（GB24）是哪类特定穴？

Front-mu point of the Gallbladder; Crossing point of the Foot-Taiyin and Foot-Shaoyang channels胆之募穴；足太阴、少阳交会穴

Main safety point at GB24?日月（GB24）最要注意的安全问题？

Never deep: the pleural recess lies above, the liver and gallbladder (right) or stomach (left) beneath.不可深刺：深部有肋膈隐窝胸膜，右侧为肝与胆囊，左侧为胃。

GB25 JīngménGB25 京门

Where is GB25 Jīngmén?京门（GB25）在哪里？

On the upper abdomen (lateral loin), below the free end of the 12th rib.上腹部，第 12 肋骨游离端的下际。

How is GB25 needled?京门（GB25）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of GB25?京门（GB25）是哪类特定穴？

Front-mu point of the Kidney肾之募穴

Main safety point at GB25?京门（GB25）最要注意的安全问题？

Do not needle deep posteromedially (kidney); use the lower depth in lean patients.不向内后方深刺（肾区）；体瘦者深度取下限。

GB26 DàimàiGB26 带脉

Where is GB26 Dàimài?带脉（GB26）在哪里？

On the lateral abdomen, where the vertical line from the free end of the 11th rib crosses the horizontal line through the umbilicus.侧腹部，第 11 肋骨游离端垂线与脐水平线的交点上。

How is GB26 needled?带脉（GB26）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of GB26?带脉（GB26）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Foot-Shaoyang channel and Dai (Girdling) vessel足少阳、带脉交会穴

Main safety point at GB26?带脉（GB26）最要注意的安全问题？

Do not needle deep medially into the abdominal cavity. Caution in pregnancy: textbooks prohibit needling lower-abdominal points in the first 3 months and abdominal or lumbosacral points after 3 months.不向腹腔内侧深刺；孕妇慎用：教材规定妊娠 3 个月以内小腹部穴禁针，3 个月以上腹部与腰骶部穴均不宜针刺。

GB27 WǔshūGB27 五枢

Where is GB27 Wǔshū?五枢（GB27）在哪里？

On the lower abdomen, level with 3 cun below the umbilicus, medial to the anterior superior iliac spine.下腹部，横平脐下 3 寸，髂前上棘内侧。

How is GB27 needled?五枢（GB27）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of GB27?五枢（GB27）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Foot-Shaoyang channel and Dai (Girdling) vessel足少阳、带脉交会穴

Main safety point at GB27?五枢（GB27）最要注意的安全问题？

Do not needle deep medially into the abdominal cavity. Caution in pregnancy: textbooks prohibit needling lower-abdominal points in the first 3 months and abdominal or lumbosacral points after 3 months.不向腹腔内侧深刺；孕妇慎用：教材规定妊娠 3 个月以内小腹部穴禁针，3 个月以上腹部与腰骶部穴均不宜针刺。

GB28 WéidàoGB28 维道

Where is GB28 Wéidào?维道（GB28）在哪里？

On the lower abdomen, 0.5 cun medioinferior to the anterior superior iliac spine.下腹部，髂前上棘内下 0.5 寸。

How is GB28 needled?维道（GB28）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique anteroinferiorly; 1–1.5 cun.直刺或向前下方斜刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of GB28?维道（GB28）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Foot-Shaoyang channel and Dai (Girdling) vessel足少阳、带脉交会穴

Main safety point at GB28?维道（GB28）最要注意的安全问题？

Do not needle deep medially into the abdominal cavity. Caution in pregnancy: textbooks prohibit needling lower-abdominal points in the first 3 months and abdominal or lumbosacral points after 3 months.不向腹腔内侧深刺；孕妇慎用：教材规定妊娠 3 个月以内小腹部穴禁针，3 个月以上腹部与腰骶部穴均不宜针刺。

GB29 JūliáoGB29 居髎

Where is GB29 Jūliáo?居髎（GB29）在哪里？

In the buttock region, at the midpoint of the line from the ASIS to the most prominent point of the greater trochanter.臀区，髂前上棘与股骨大转子最凸点连线的中点处。

How is GB29 needled?居髎（GB29）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of GB29?居髎（GB29）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Yang Heel vessel and Foot-Shaoyang channel阳跷脉、足少阳交会穴

Main safety point at GB29?居髎（GB29）最要注意的安全问题？

The lateral femoral cutaneous nerve emerges below the ASIS; drifting forward irritates it (numb lateral thigh).浅层股外侧皮神经出髂前上棘内下方，取穴偏前会刺激它（大腿外侧麻）。

GB30 HuántiàoGB30 环跳

Where is GB30 Huántiào?环跳（GB30）在哪里？

In the buttock region, at the junction of the lateral third and medial two thirds of the line from the most prominent point of the greater trochanter to the sacral hiatus.臀区，股骨大转子最凸点与骶管裂孔连线的外 1/3 与内 2/3 交点处。

How is GB30 needled?环跳（GB30）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 2–3 cun.直刺；2–3 寸。

Special-point roles of GB30?环跳（GB30）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Foot-Taiyang and Foot-Shaoyang channels足太阳、少阳交会穴

Main safety point at GB30?环跳（GB30）最要注意的安全问题？

The sciatic nerve lies directly deep: on an electric shooting sensation withdraw slightly and do not keep thrusting; never angle steeply superomedially toward the greater sciatic foramen.深部正当坐骨神经：触电样放射感即退针少许，不反复提插捣刺；不向内上方大角度斜刺（坐骨大孔）。

GB31 FēngshìGB31 风市

Where is GB31 Fēngshì?风市（GB31）在哪里？

On the thigh, in the depression posterior to the iliotibial band where the tip of the middle finger rests when standing with the arms hanging and the palm against the thigh.股部，直立垂手，掌心贴于大腿时，中指尖所指凹陷中，髂胫束后缘。

How is GB31 needled?风市（GB31）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Main safety point at GB31?风市（GB31）最要注意的安全问题？

Deep needling too far back nears the sciatic nerve; the iliotibial band is tough, so insert with the patient relaxed on the side.偏后深刺接近坐骨神经；髂胫束坚韧，放松侧卧再进针以免滞针。

GB32 ZhōngdúGB32 中渎

Where is GB32 Zhōngdú?中渎（GB32）在哪里？

On the thigh, 7 cun above the popliteal crease, posterior to the iliotibial band.股部，腘横纹上 7 寸，髂胫束后缘。

How is GB32 needled?中渎（GB32）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Main safety point at GB32?中渎（GB32）最要注意的安全问题？

Insert straight behind the iliotibial band; do not angle posteromedially toward the sciatic nerve and perforating arteries.沿髂胫束后缘直刺，不向后内斜刺（坐骨神经、股深动脉穿支）。

GB33 XīyángguānGB33 膝阳关

Where is GB33 Xīyángguān?膝阳关（GB33）在哪里？

On the knee, in the depression posterosuperior to the lateral epicondyle of the femur, between the biceps femoris tendon and the iliotibial band.膝部，股骨外上髁后上缘，股二头肌腱与髂胫束之间的凹陷中。

How is GB33 needled?膝阳关（GB33）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Main safety point at GB33?膝阳关（GB33）最要注意的安全问题？

The common fibular nerve descends along the medial side of the biceps tendon: do not cross the tendon into the popliteal fossa.腓总神经沿股二头肌腱内侧下行：针不越过肌腱向腘窝深刺。

GB34 YánglíngquánGB34 阳陵泉

Where is GB34 Yánglíngquán?阳陵泉（GB34）在哪里？

On the lateral leg, in the depression anterior and inferior to the head of the fibula.小腿外侧，腓骨头前下方凹陷中。

How is GB34 needled?阳陵泉（GB34）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of GB34?阳陵泉（GB34）是哪类特定穴？

He-sea point (earth); Lower he-sea point of the Gallbladder; Influential point of the sinews合穴（土）；胆下合穴；八会穴之筋会

Main safety point at GB34?阳陵泉（GB34）最要注意的安全问题？

The common fibular nerve winds round the fibular neck and is most superficial directly below and behind the fibular head: stay strictly anteroinferior and withdraw on any electric sensation to the foot.腓总神经绕腓骨颈、在腓骨头正下方与后下方最表浅：取穴严格在前下方，出现向足背放射的触电感即退针。

GB35 YángjiāoGB35 阳交

Where is GB35 Yángjiāo?阳交（GB35）在哪里？

On the lateral leg, 7 cun above the prominence of the lateral malleolus, posterior to the fibula.小腿外侧，外踝尖上 7 寸，腓骨后缘。

How is GB35 needled?阳交（GB35）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of GB35?阳交（GB35）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point of the Yang Linking vessel阳维脉郄穴

Main safety point at GB35?阳交（GB35）最要注意的安全问题？

The superficial fibular nerve pierces the deep fascia in the lower third of the lateral leg; redirect on any electric sensation to the dorsum of the foot.小腿外侧腓浅神经在中下 1/3 穿出深筋膜；出现向足背放射的麻电感即调整针向。

GB36 WàiqiūGB36 外丘

Where is GB36 Wàiqiū?外丘（GB36）在哪里？

On the lateral leg, 7 cun above the prominence of the lateral malleolus, anterior to the fibula.小腿外侧，外踝尖上 7 寸，腓骨前缘。

How is GB36 needled?外丘（GB36）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of GB36?外丘（GB36）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point郄穴

Main safety point at GB36?外丘（GB36）最要注意的安全问题？

The superficial fibular nerve pierces the deep fascia in the lower third of the lateral leg; redirect on any electric sensation to the dorsum of the foot.小腿外侧腓浅神经在中下 1/3 穿出深筋膜；出现向足背放射的麻电感即调整针向。

GB37 GuāngmíngGB37 光明

Where is GB37 Guāngmíng?光明（GB37）在哪里？

On the lateral leg, 5 cun above the prominence of the lateral malleolus, anterior to the fibula.小腿外侧，外踝尖上 5 寸，腓骨前缘。

How is GB37 needled?光明（GB37）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of GB37?光明（GB37）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point络穴

Main safety point at GB37?光明（GB37）最要注意的安全问题？

The superficial fibular nerve pierces the deep fascia in the lower third of the lateral leg; redirect on any electric sensation to the dorsum of the foot.小腿外侧腓浅神经在中下 1/3 穿出深筋膜；出现向足背放射的麻电感即调整针向。

GB38 YángfǔGB38 阳辅

Where is GB38 Yángfǔ?阳辅（GB38）在哪里？

On the lateral leg, 4 cun above the prominence of the lateral malleolus, anterior to the fibula.小腿外侧，外踝尖上 4 寸，腓骨前缘。

How is GB38 needled?阳辅（GB38）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.8–1.2 cun.直刺；0.8–1.2 寸。

Special-point roles of GB38?阳辅（GB38）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river point (fire)经穴（火）

Main safety point at GB38?阳辅（GB38）最要注意的安全问题？

The superficial fibular nerve pierces the deep fascia in the lower third of the lateral leg; redirect on any electric sensation to the dorsum of the foot.小腿外侧腓浅神经在中下 1/3 穿出深筋膜；出现向足背放射的麻电感即调整针向。

GB39 XuánzhōngGB39 悬钟

Where is GB39 Xuánzhōng?悬钟（GB39）在哪里？

On the lateral leg, 3 cun above the prominence of the lateral malleolus, anterior to the fibula.小腿外侧，外踝尖上 3 寸，腓骨前缘。

How is GB39 needled?悬钟（GB39）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of GB39?悬钟（GB39）是哪类特定穴？

Influential point of the marrow八会穴之髓会

Main safety point at GB39?悬钟（GB39）最要注意的安全问题？

The superficial fibular nerve pierces the deep fascia in the lower third of the lateral leg; redirect on any electric sensation to the dorsum of the foot.小腿外侧腓浅神经在中下 1/3 穿出深筋膜；出现向足背放射的麻电感即调整针向。

GB40 QiūxūGB40 丘墟

Where is GB40 Qiūxū?丘墟（GB40）在哪里？

In the ankle region, anteroinferior to the lateral malleolus, in the depression lateral to the extensor digitorum longus tendon.踝区，外踝的前下方，趾长伸肌腱的外侧凹陷中。

How is GB40 needled?丘墟（GB40）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of GB40?丘墟（GB40）是哪类特定穴？

Yuan-source point原穴

Main safety point at GB40?丘墟（GB40）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid superficial dorsal veins; in acute ankle sprain rule out fracture before local needling.避开足背浅静脉；外踝急性扭伤先排除骨折再局部针刺。

GB41 ZúlínqìGB41 足临泣

Where is GB41 Zúlínqì?足临泣（GB41）在哪里？

On the dorsum of the foot, distal to the junction of the bases of the 4th and 5th metatarsals, in the depression lateral to the extensor tendon of the 5th toe.足背，第 4、5 跖骨底结合部的前方，第 5 趾长伸肌腱外侧凹陷中。

How is GB41 needled?足临泣（GB41）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of GB41?足临泣（GB41）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream point (wood); Confluent point of the eight extraordinary vessels (Dai vessel)输穴（木）；八脉交会穴（通带脉）

Main safety point at GB41?足临泣（GB41）最要注意的安全问题？

Thin skin with superficial veins on the dorsum; avoid them and press after withdrawal.足背皮薄、静脉表浅，避开血管；出针按压。

GB42 DìwǔhuìGB42 地五会

Where is GB42 Dìwǔhuì?地五会（GB42）在哪里？

On the dorsum of the foot, between the 4th and 5th metatarsals, in the depression proximal to the 4th metatarsophalangeal joint.足背，第 4、5 跖骨间，第 4 跖趾关节近端凹陷中。

How is GB42 needled?地五会（GB42）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at GB42?地五会（GB42）最要注意的安全问题？

The Jiayi Jing forbids moxibustion; the thin dorsal skin burns easily with direct moxa.《甲乙经》载不可灸；足背皮薄，直接灸易烫伤。

GB43 XiáxīGB43 侠溪

Where is GB43 Xiáxī?侠溪（GB43）在哪里？

On the dorsum of the foot, between the 4th and 5th toes, proximal to the web margin, at the border of the red and white skin.足背，第 4、5 趾间，趾蹼缘后方赤白肉际处。

How is GB43 needled?侠溪（GB43）怎么刺？

Perpendicular or oblique; 0.3–0.5 cun.直刺或斜刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of GB43?侠溪（GB43）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring point (water)荥穴（水）

Main safety point at GB43?侠溪（GB43）最要注意的安全问题？

Avoid dorsal digital veins; take care needling toes in diabetic feet or poor leg circulation.避开趾背静脉；糖尿病足或下肢循环差者慎针足趾。

GB44 ZúqiàoyīnGB44 足窍阴

Where is GB44 Zúqiàoyīn?足窍阴（GB44）在哪里？

On the 4th toe, lateral to the distal phalanx, 0.1 F-cun proximal-lateral to the lateral corner of the toenail.足趾，第 4 趾末节外侧，趾甲根角侧后方 0.1 寸（指寸）。

How is GB44 needled?足窍阴（GB44）怎么刺？

Shallow insertion; 0.1–0.2 cun.浅刺；0.1–0.2 寸。

Special-point roles of GB44?足窍阴（GB44）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well point (metal)井穴（金）

Main safety point at GB44?足窍阴（GB44）最要注意的安全问题？

Disinfect strictly before pricking; avoid bloodletting in diabetic feet or bleeding disorders.点刺前严格消毒；糖尿病足、凝血障碍者不宜点刺出血。

LR1 DàdūnLR1 大敦

Where is LR1 Dàdūn?大敦（LR1）在哪里？

On the great toe, lateral to the distal phalanx, 0.1 F-cun proximal-lateral to the lateral corner of the toenail.足趾，大趾末节外侧，趾甲根角侧后方 0.1 寸（指寸）。

How is LR1 needled?大敦（LR1）怎么刺？

Shallow insertion, or prick to bleed; 0.1–0.2 cun.浅刺，或点刺出血；0.1–0.2 寸。

Special-point roles of LR1?大敦（LR1）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-well (wood)井穴（木）

Main safety point at LR1?大敦（LR1）最要注意的安全问题？

The toe tip has thin, very sensitive skin with the distal phalanx immediately beneath: stay shallow and avoid the nail bed; disinfect carefully before pricking to bleed, and take care in diabetic feet or peripheral vascular disease.趾端皮薄、痛觉敏感，针下即是末节趾骨：浅刺即止，避开甲床；点刺出血前严格消毒，糖尿病足、周围血管病患者慎刺。

LR2 XíngjiānLR2 行间

Where is LR2 Xíngjiān?行间（LR2）在哪里？

On the dorsum of the foot, between the first and second toes, proximal to the web margin, at the border of the red and white flesh.足背，第 1、2 趾间，趾蹼缘后方赤白肉际处。

How is LR2 needled?行间（LR2）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LR2?行间（LR2）是哪类特定穴？

Ying-spring (fire)荥穴（火）

Main safety point at LR2?行间（LR2）最要注意的安全问题？

Soft tissue behind the web is thin with dorsal digital veins under the skin: avoid visible veins and do not drive into the metatarsophalangeal joint capsules.趾蹼后软组织薄，皮下有趾背静脉：避开可见静脉，不向跖趾关节囊深刺。

LR3 TàichōngLR3 太冲

Where is LR3 Tàichōng?太冲（LR3）在哪里？

On the dorsum of the foot, between the first and second metatarsal bones, in the depression distal to the junction of their bases, over the dorsalis pedis pulse.足背，第 1、2 跖骨间，跖骨底结合部前方凹陷中，或触及动脉搏动处。

How is LR3 needled?太冲（LR3）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LR3?太冲（LR3）是哪类特定穴？

Shu-stream (earth), Yuan-source point输穴（土）、原穴

Main safety point at LR3?太冲（LR3）最要注意的安全问题？

The dorsalis pedis and first dorsal metatarsal arteries lie directly beneath: feel the pulse first, insert beside it and avoid the veins; a punctured artery bruises easily, so press after withdrawal.足背动脉与第 1 跖背动脉就在穴下：先摸清搏动，针从搏动旁进入，避开静脉；刺破动脉易成血肿，出针后按压。

LR4 ZhōngfēngLR4 中封

Where is LR4 Zhōngfēng?中封（LR4）在哪里？

On the anteromedial ankle, anterior to the medial malleolus, in the depression medial to the tendon of tibialis anterior.踝区，内踝前，胫骨前肌腱的内侧缘凹陷中。

How is LR4 needled?中封（LR4）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LR4?中封（LR4）是哪类特定穴？

Jing-river (metal)经穴（金）

Main safety point at LR4?中封（LR4）最要注意的安全问题？

The great saphenous vein and saphenous nerve pass in front of the medial malleolus: locate the vein first and keep the needle out of the ankle joint capsule.大隐静脉与隐神经从内踝前方经过：先看清静脉；针尖不进踝关节囊。

LR5 LígōuLR5 蠡沟

Where is LR5 Lígōu?蠡沟（LR5）在哪里？

On the medial leg, 5 cun above the prominence of the medial malleolus, at the centre of the medial surface of the tibia.小腿内侧，内踝尖上 5 寸，胫骨内侧面的中央。

How is LR5 needled?蠡沟（LR5）怎么刺？

Transverse (along the bone surface); 0.5–0.8 cun.平刺（沿骨面向上或向下）；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LR5?蠡沟（LR5）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point络穴

Main safety point at LR5?蠡沟（LR5）最要注意的安全问题？

Tissue over the bone is very thin: insert transversely along the surface rather than straight onto the periosteum, and avoid the great saphenous vein.骨面上皮下组织很薄：贴骨面平刺，不直刺抵骨膜；避开大隐静脉。

LR6 ZhōngdūLR6 中都

Where is LR6 Zhōngdū?中都（LR6）在哪里？

On the medial leg, 7 cun above the prominence of the medial malleolus, at the centre of the medial surface of the tibia.小腿内侧，内踝尖上 7 寸，胫骨内侧面的中央。

How is LR6 needled?中都（LR6）怎么刺？

Transverse (along the bone surface); 0.5–0.8 cun.平刺（沿骨面）；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LR6?中都（LR6）是哪类特定穴？

Xi-cleft point郄穴

Main safety point at LR6?中都（LR6）最要注意的安全问题？

As at LR5: the bone is shallow; insert transversely along the surface, avoid the great saphenous vein, and do not strike the periosteum.同蠡沟：骨面浅，贴骨面平刺，避开大隐静脉，不直刺抵骨膜。

LR7 XīguānLR7 膝关

Where is LR7 Xīguān?膝关（LR7）在哪里？

On the medial knee, inferior to the medial condyle of the tibia, 1 cun posterior to SP9.膝部，胫骨内侧髁的下方，阴陵泉后 1 寸。

How is LR7 needled?膝关（LR7）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Main safety point at LR7?膝关（LR7）最要注意的安全问题？

Driving deep posterolaterally approaches the posterior tibial vessels and tibial nerve: keep perpendicular, do not angle toward the centre of the popliteal fossa, and withdraw at electric tingling into the sole.针向外后深进会接近胫后血管与胫神经：保持直刺、不偏向腘窝中央；出现向足底放射的电麻感即退针。

LR8 QūquánLR8 曲泉

Where is LR8 Qūquán?曲泉（LR8）在哪里？

On the medial knee, at the medial end of the popliteal crease, in the depression medial to the tendon of semitendinosus.膝部，腘横纹内侧端，半腱肌肌腱内缘凹陷中。

How is LR8 needled?曲泉（LR8）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of LR8?曲泉（LR8）是哪类特定穴？

He-sea (water)合穴（水）

Main safety point at LR8?曲泉（LR8）最要注意的安全问题？

Locate with the knee flexed; do not aim toward the centre of the popliteal fossa (popliteal vessels and tibial nerve), and avoid the great saphenous vein.屈膝取穴；针不朝腘窝中央，以免接近腘动静脉与胫神经；避开大隐静脉。

LR9 YīnbāoLR9 阴包

Where is LR9 Yīnbāo?阴包（LR9）在哪里？

On the medial thigh, 4 cun above the base of the patella, between gracilis and sartorius.股前区，髌底上 4 寸，股薄肌与缝匠肌之间。

How is LR9 needled?阴包（LR9）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.8–1 cun.直刺；0.8–1 寸。

Main safety point at LR9?阴包（LR9）最要注意的安全问题？

The femoral vessels lie deep to sartorius, anterolateral to the needle path: do not angle deep anterolaterally, and avoid the great saphenous vein.股动静脉在缝匠肌深面、针路前外侧：针不斜向前外深刺；避开大隐静脉。

LR10 ZúwǔlǐLR10 足五里

Where is LR10 Zúwǔlǐ?足五里（LR10）在哪里？

On the medial thigh, 3 cun directly below ST30, over the pulsation of the artery.股前区，气冲直下 3 寸，动脉搏动处。

How is LR10 needled?足五里（LR10）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, avoiding the artery; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺，避开动脉；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at LR10?足五里（LR10）最要注意的安全问题？

The femoral vessels lie deep and lateral and a pulse is often felt here: palpate it first, enter medial to it and never angle deep superolaterally; press firmly if an artery is punctured. Obtain consent and drape this private region.股动静脉在外侧深处、穴下常有搏动：先摸清搏动，针从其内侧避开进入，不向外上深刺；刺破动脉须持续压迫。隐私部位须先取得同意并遮盖。

LR11 YīnliánLR11 阴廉

Where is LR11 Yīnlián?阴廉（LR11）在哪里？

On the medial thigh, 2 cun directly below ST30.股前区，气冲直下 2 寸。

How is LR11 needled?阴廉（LR11）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, avoiding the artery; 0.8–1 cun.直刺，避开动脉；0.8–1 寸。

Main safety point at LR11?阴廉（LR11）最要注意的安全问题？

Closer to the groin than LR10, with the femoral vessels deep and lateral: palpate the pulse, enter medial to it and do not angle deep superolaterally. Obtain consent and drape this private region.比足五里更靠近腹股沟，外侧深处是股动静脉：先摸清搏动，针在其内侧进入，不向外上深刺。隐私部位须先取得同意并遮盖。

LR12 JímàiLR12 急脉

Where is LR12 Jímài?急脉（LR12）在哪里？

In the groin region, level with the upper border of the pubic symphysis, 2.5 cun lateral to the anterior midline.腹股沟区，横平耻骨联合上缘，前正中线旁开 2.5 寸。

How is LR12 needled?急脉（LR12）怎么刺？

Perpendicular, avoiding the artery; 0.5–0.8 cun.直刺，避开动脉；0.5–0.8 寸。

Main safety point at LR12?急脉（LR12）最要注意的安全问题？

Contraindicated in pregnancy. The femoral vein is lateral and the spermatic cord or round ligament and inguinal canal deep: avoid the pulse, stay shallow without lifting-thrusting and never aim into the abdomen; obtain consent and drape professionally.孕期禁针。外侧有股静脉、深面有精索或子宫圆韧带与腹股沟管：避开搏动，浅刺不提插，不向腹腔方向进针；须先取得同意并专业遮盖。

LR13 ZhāngménLR13 章门

Where is LR13 Zhāngmén?章门（LR13）在哪里？

On the lateral abdomen, just inferior to the free extremity of the 11th rib.侧腹部，在第 11 肋游离端的下际。

How is LR13 needled?章门（LR13）怎么刺？

Oblique; 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LR13?章门（LR13）是哪类特定穴？

Front-mu point of the Spleen; Influential point of the zang organs; Crossing point of the Liver and Gallbladder channels脾之募穴；八会穴之脏会；足厥阴、足少阳经交会穴

Main safety point at LR13?章门（LR13）最要注意的安全问题？

The liver lies deep on the right and the spleen on the left, and an enlarged organ can reach beneath the point: use shallow oblique insertion only, no deep perpendicular insertion or wide lifting-thrusting, and never deep needling over an enlarged liver or spleen.深面右为肝、左为脾，肝脾肿大时脏器下缘可达穴下：只作浅斜刺，不深直刺、不大幅提插；肝脾肿大者禁深刺。

LR14 QīménLR14 期门

Where is LR14 Qīmén?期门（LR14）在哪里？

On the anterior chest, in the 6th intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline.胸部，第 6 肋间隙，前正中线旁开 4 寸。

How is LR14 needled?期门（LR14）怎么刺？

Oblique or transverse (laterally along the intercostal space); 0.5–0.8 cun.斜刺或平刺（沿肋间向外）；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of LR14?期门（LR14）是哪类特定穴？

Front-mu point of the Liver; Crossing point of the Spleen and Liver channels and the Yin Linking vessel肝之募穴；足太阴、足厥阴、阴维脉交会穴

Main safety point at LR14?期门（LR14）最要注意的安全问题？

Pleura and lung lie just deep to the intercostal muscles, with the liver below on the right and the heart above-medial on the left: insert only obliquely or transversely laterally along the space, never perpendicularly or deep medially—risk of pneumothorax.肋间肌深面就是胸膜和肺，右侧下方邻肝、左侧内上方邻心：只沿肋间向外斜刺或平刺，不直刺、不向内深刺，有气胸风险。

GV1 ChángqiángGV1 长强

Where is GV1 Chángqiáng?长强（GV1）在哪里？

In the perineal region, below the coccyx, midway between the tip of the coccyx and the anus.会阴区，尾骨下方，尾骨端与肛门连线的中点处。

How is GV1 needled?长强（GV1）怎么刺？

Oblique upward, keeping close to the anterior surface of the coccyx; 0.8–1 cun.紧靠尾骨前面向上斜刺；0.8–1 寸。

Special-point roles of GV1?长强（GV1）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point of the Governor Vessel; Crossing point of the Governor Vessel with the Foot-Shaoyang and Foot-Shaoyin channels督脉络穴；督脉、足少阳、足少阴交会穴

Main safety point at GV1?长强（GV1）最要注意的安全问题？

The rectum lies directly in front: keep the needle against the front of the coccyx pointing upward, never perpendicular or angled forward; do not needle over a perianal abscess or fissure.直肠就在穴位前方：针体须贴尾骨前面向上，不可直刺或偏向前方；局部有肛周脓肿、肛裂时不刺。

GV2 YāoshūGV2 腰俞

Where is GV2 Yāoshū?腰俞（GV2）在哪里？

In the sacral region, directly over the sacral hiatus, on the posterior midline.骶区，正对骶管裂孔，后正中线上。

How is GV2 needled?腰俞（GV2）怎么刺？

Oblique upward; 0.5–1 cun.向上斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV2?腰俞（GV2）最要注意的安全问题？

The sacral canal lies under the hiatus; deep needling can enter the epidural space and irritate sacral nerves, so withdraw on any electric sensation into the legs or perineum. Avoid the lumbosacral region after 3 months of pregnancy.裂孔下即骶管，深刺可进入硬膜外腔刺激骶神经；出现下肢或会阴放射麻电感即退针。妊娠 3 个月以上腰骶部不宜针。

GV3 YāoyángguānGV3 腰阳关

Where is GV3 Yāoyángguān?腰阳关（GV3）在哪里？

In the lumbar region, in the depression below the spinous process of L4, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 4 腰椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV3 needled?腰阳关（GV3）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV3?腰阳关（GV3）最要注意的安全问题？

Through the ligamentum flavum lies the canal and cauda equina; withdraw at once on a sudden give or an electric sensation down the legs. Avoid the lumbosacral region after 3 months of pregnancy.穿过黄韧带即入椎管、触及马尾；有落空感或下肢放射麻电感立即退针。妊娠 3 个月以上腰骶部不宜针。

GV4 MìngménGV4 命门

Where is GV4 Mìngmén?命门（GV4）在哪里？

In the lumbar region, in the depression below the spinous process of L2, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 2 腰椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV4 needled?命门（GV4）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV4?命门（GV4）最要注意的安全问题？

In adults the conus ends around the lower L1 to L2 level, so the conus tip and upper cauda equina lie beneath; never needle through the ligamentum flavum. Avoid the lumbosacral region after 3 months of pregnancy.成人脊髓圆锥多止于第 1 腰椎下缘至第 2 腰椎，命门深面为圆锥末端与马尾起始；不可深刺透黄韧带。妊娠 3 个月以上腰骶部不宜针。

GV5 XuánshūGV5 悬枢

Where is GV5 Xuánshū?悬枢（GV5）在哪里？

In the lumbar region, in the depression below the spinous process of L1, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 1 腰椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV5 needled?悬枢（GV5）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 0.5–1 cun.直刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV5?悬枢（GV5）最要注意的安全问题？

The conus medullaris may lie directly beneath; withdraw on a give or an electric sensation into the legs, and do not lift-thrust.深面可能正当脊髓圆锥；有落空感或触电感放射至下肢即退针，不提插捣针。

GV6 JǐzhōngGV6 脊中

Where is GV6 Jǐzhōng?脊中（GV6）在哪里？

On the back, in the depression below the spinous process of T11, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 11 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV6 needled?脊中（GV6）怎么刺？

Oblique upward; 0.5–1 cun.向上斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV6?脊中（GV6）最要注意的安全问题？

Thoracic spinous processes slope downward like roof tiles, so angle upward along the interspinous gap; a give (through the ligamentum flavum) or an electric sensation into the limbs means withdraw at once.胸段棘突呈叠瓦状向下，针尖须向上斜刺顺棘突间隙；有落空感（穿过黄韧带）或触电感向肢体放射即退针，不可再进。

GV7 ZhōngshūGV7 中枢

Where is GV7 Zhōngshū?中枢（GV7）在哪里？

On the back, in the depression below the spinous process of T10, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 10 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV7 needled?中枢（GV7）怎么刺？

Oblique upward; 0.5–1 cun.向上斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV7?中枢（GV7）最要注意的安全问题？

Thoracic spinous processes slope downward like roof tiles, so angle upward along the interspinous gap; a give (through the ligamentum flavum) or an electric sensation into the limbs means withdraw at once.胸段棘突呈叠瓦状向下，针尖须向上斜刺顺棘突间隙；有落空感（穿过黄韧带）或触电感向肢体放射即退针，不可再进。

GV8 JīnsuōGV8 筋缩

Where is GV8 Jīnsuō?筋缩（GV8）在哪里？

On the back, in the depression below the spinous process of T9, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 9 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV8 needled?筋缩（GV8）怎么刺？

Oblique upward; 0.5–1 cun.向上斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV8?筋缩（GV8）最要注意的安全问题？

Thoracic spinous processes slope downward like roof tiles, so angle upward along the interspinous gap; a give (through the ligamentum flavum) or an electric sensation into the limbs means withdraw at once.胸段棘突呈叠瓦状向下，针尖须向上斜刺顺棘突间隙；有落空感（穿过黄韧带）或触电感向肢体放射即退针，不可再进。

GV9 ZhìyángGV9 至阳

Where is GV9 Zhìyáng?至阳（GV9）在哪里？

On the back, in the depression below the spinous process of T7, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 7 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV9 needled?至阳（GV9）怎么刺？

Oblique upward; 0.5–1 cun.向上斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV9?至阳（GV9）最要注意的安全问题？

Thoracic spinous processes slope downward like roof tiles, so angle upward along the interspinous gap; a give (through the ligamentum flavum) or an electric sensation into the limbs means withdraw at once.胸段棘突呈叠瓦状向下，针尖须向上斜刺顺棘突间隙；有落空感（穿过黄韧带）或触电感向肢体放射即退针，不可再进。

GV10 LíngtáiGV10 灵台

Where is GV10 Língtái?灵台（GV10）在哪里？

On the back, in the depression below the spinous process of T6, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 6 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV10 needled?灵台（GV10）怎么刺？

Oblique upward; 0.5–1 cun.向上斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV10?灵台（GV10）最要注意的安全问题？

Thoracic spinous processes slope downward like roof tiles, so angle upward along the interspinous gap; a give (through the ligamentum flavum) or an electric sensation into the limbs means withdraw at once.胸段棘突呈叠瓦状向下，针尖须向上斜刺顺棘突间隙；有落空感（穿过黄韧带）或触电感向肢体放射即退针，不可再进。

GV11 ShéndàoGV11 神道

Where is GV11 Shéndào?神道（GV11）在哪里？

On the back, in the depression below the spinous process of T5, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 5 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV11 needled?神道（GV11）怎么刺？

Oblique upward; 0.5–1 cun.向上斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV11?神道（GV11）最要注意的安全问题？

Thoracic spinous processes slope downward like roof tiles, so angle upward along the interspinous gap; a give (through the ligamentum flavum) or an electric sensation into the limbs means withdraw at once.胸段棘突呈叠瓦状向下，针尖须向上斜刺顺棘突间隙；有落空感（穿过黄韧带）或触电感向肢体放射即退针，不可再进。

GV12 ShēnzhùGV12 身柱

Where is GV12 Shēnzhù?身柱（GV12）在哪里？

On the back, in the depression below the spinous process of T3, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 3 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV12 needled?身柱（GV12）怎么刺？

Oblique upward; 0.5–1 cun.向上斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Main safety point at GV12?身柱（GV12）最要注意的安全问题？

Thoracic spinous processes slope downward like roof tiles, so angle upward along the interspinous gap; a give (through the ligamentum flavum) or an electric sensation into the limbs means withdraw at once.胸段棘突呈叠瓦状向下，针尖须向上斜刺顺棘突间隙；有落空感（穿过黄韧带）或触电感向肢体放射即退针，不可再进。

GV13 TáodàoGV13 陶道

Where is GV13 Táodào?陶道（GV13）在哪里？

On the back, in the depression below the spinous process of T1, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 1 胸椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV13 needled?陶道（GV13）怎么刺？

Oblique upward; 0.5–1 cun.向上斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of GV13?陶道（GV13）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Governor Vessel and Foot-Taiyang channel督脉、足太阳交会穴

Main safety point at GV13?陶道（GV13）最要注意的安全问题？

Thoracic spinous processes slope downward like roof tiles, so angle upward along the interspinous gap; a give (through the ligamentum flavum) or an electric sensation into the limbs means withdraw at once.胸段棘突呈叠瓦状向下，针尖须向上斜刺顺棘突间隙；有落空感（穿过黄韧带）或触电感向肢体放射即退针，不可再进。

GV14 DàzhuīGV14 大椎

Where is GV14 Dàzhuī?大椎（GV14）在哪里？

In the upper back, in the depression below the spinous process of C7, on the posterior midline.脊柱区，第 7 颈椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。

How is GV14 needled?大椎（GV14）怎么刺？

Oblique upward; 0.5–1 cun.向上斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of GV14?大椎（GV14）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Governor Vessel with the three hand and three foot yang channels督脉与手足三阳经交会穴（诸阳之会）

Main safety point at GV14?大椎（GV14）最要注意的安全问题？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Main safety point at CV9?水分（CV9）最要注意的安全问题？

With marked ascites the wall is tense and bowel lies close, so prefer moxa over deep needling; caution in pregnancy.腹水明显时腹壁张力高、肠管贴近，宜灸不宜深刺；孕妇慎用。

CV10 XiàwǎnCV10 下脘

Where is CV10 Xiàwǎn?下脘（CV10）在哪里？

On the upper abdomen, 2 cun above the centre of the umbilicus, on the anterior midline.上腹部，脐中上 2 寸，前正中线上。

How is CV10 needled?下脘（CV10）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of CV10?下脘（CV10）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Conception Vessel and Foot-Taiyin channel任脉、足太阴交会穴

Main safety point at CV10?下脘（CV10）最要注意的安全问题？

Do not needle deep after a full meal, with bloating, or over an undiagnosed mass; caution in pregnancy.饱餐后、肠胀气或腹部包块未明者不深刺；孕妇慎用。

CV11 JiànlǐCV11 建里

Where is CV11 Jiànlǐ?建里（CV11）在哪里？

On the upper abdomen, 3 cun above the centre of the umbilicus, on the anterior midline.上腹部，脐中上 3 寸，前正中线上。

How is CV11 needled?建里（CV11）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Main safety point at CV11?建里（CV11）最要注意的安全问题？

Do not needle deep with a full stomach; persistent severe epigastric pain needs evaluation for an acute abdomen first.饱餐后胃充盈时不深刺；上腹持续剧痛先排除急腹症。

CV12 ZhōngwǎnCV12 中脘

Where is CV12 Zhōngwǎn?中脘（CV12）在哪里？

On the upper abdomen, 4 cun above the centre of the umbilicus, on the anterior midline.上腹部，脐中上 4 寸，前正中线上。

How is CV12 needled?中脘（CV12）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of CV12?中脘（CV12）是哪类特定穴？

Front-mu point of the Stomach; Influential point of the fu organs; Crossing point of the Conception Vessel with Hand-Taiyang, Hand-Shaoyang and Foot-Yangming胃募穴；八会穴之腑会；任脉、手太阳、手少阳、足阳明交会穴

Main safety point at CV12?中脘（CV12）最要注意的安全问题？

The stomach lies beneath and an enlarged left liver lobe may reach here: do not needle deep after a meal or with hepatosplenomegaly; severe epigastric pain or bloody vomit/black stool needs medical care first.深面为胃，肝大者肝左叶可下达此处：饱餐后、肝脾大者不深刺；上腹剧痛、呕血黑便先就医。

CV13 ShàngwǎnCV13 上脘

Where is CV13 Shàngwǎn?上脘（CV13）在哪里？

On the upper abdomen, 5 cun above the centre of the umbilicus, on the anterior midline.上腹部，脐中上 5 寸，前正中线上。

How is CV13 needled?上脘（CV13）怎么刺？

Perpendicular; 1–1.5 cun.直刺；1–1.5 寸。

Special-point roles of CV13?上脘（CV13）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Conception Vessel with Foot-Yangming and Hand-Taiyang任脉、足阳明、手太阳交会穴

Main safety point at CV13?上脘（CV13）最要注意的安全问题？

The left liver lobe and stomach lie beneath; do not needle deep with an enlarged liver or after a meal, and do not angle upward.深面有肝左叶与胃，肝大、饱餐后不深刺，针尖不向上斜。

CV14 JùquèCV14 巨阙

Where is CV14 Jùquè?巨阙（CV14）在哪里？

On the upper abdomen, 6 cun above the centre of the umbilicus, on the anterior midline.上腹部，脐中上 6 寸，前正中线上。

How is CV14 needled?巨阙（CV14）怎么刺？

Oblique downward; 0.5–1 cun.向下斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of CV14?巨阙（CV14）是哪类特定穴？

Front-mu point of the Heart心募穴

Main safety point at CV14?巨阙（CV14）最要注意的安全问题？

The left liver lobe lies beneath, and an upward tip points at the diaphragm and heart: angle downward only and stay shallow, with extra care in hepatomegaly or cardiomegaly. Chest pain needs cardiac emergencies ruled out first.深面为肝左叶，针尖向上则朝向膈肌与心脏：只向下斜刺、不深刺；肝大、心脏扩大者尤须谨慎。胸痛先排除心血管急症。

CV15 JiūwěiCV15 鸠尾

Where is CV15 Jiūwěi?鸠尾（CV15）在哪里？

On the upper abdomen, 1 cun below the xiphisternal junction, on the anterior midline.上腹部，剑胸结合下 1 寸，前正中线上。

How is CV15 needled?鸠尾（CV15）怎么刺？

Oblique downward; 0.5–1 cun.向下斜刺；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of CV15?鸠尾（CV15）是哪类特定穴？

Luo-connecting point of the Conception Vessel; Source point of the gao (fatty tissue)任脉络穴；膏之原

Main safety point at CV15?鸠尾（CV15）最要注意的安全问题？

Below the xiphoid an upward tip nears the diaphragm, pericardium and heart, and the left liver lobe lies beneath: angle downward only, never deep or upward. The Jiayi Jing once listed it as forbidden.剑突下针尖向上即近膈肌、心包与心脏，深面又有肝左叶：只向下斜刺，不深刺、不向上；《甲乙经》曾列禁刺。

CV16 ZhōngtíngCV16 中庭

Where is CV16 Zhōngtíng?中庭（CV16）在哪里？

On the chest, at the midpoint of the xiphisternal junction, on the anterior midline.胸部，剑胸结合中点处，前正中线上。

How is CV16 needled?中庭（CV16）怎么刺？

Transverse; 0.3–0.5 cun.平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at CV16?中庭（CV16）最要注意的安全问题？

Bone is thin at the xiphisternal junction with the pericardium and lower heart behind; off the midline lie the intercostal space and pleura, risking pneumothorax. Needle subcutaneously only.胸剑结合处骨板薄，后方即心包与心脏下缘；偏离中线则近肋间、胸膜，有气胸风险。只沿皮下平刺。

CV17 DànzhōngCV17 膻中

Where is CV17 Dànzhōng?膻中（CV17）在哪里？

On the chest, level with the 4th intercostal space, on the anterior midline.胸部，横平第 4 肋间隙，前正中线上。

How is CV17 needled?膻中（CV17）怎么刺？

Transverse; 0.3–0.5 cun.平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of CV17?膻中（CV17）是哪类特定穴？

Front-mu point of the Pericardium; Influential point of qi心包募穴；八会穴之气会

Main safety point at CV17?膻中（CV17）最要注意的安全问题？

A congenital foramen in the lower sternum is not rare (autopsy and CT studies report about 4–13%) and cannot be felt: a perpendicular needle can pass through it into the pericardium and heart, and fatal tamponade has been reported. Needle only transversely under the skin; drifting laterally into the intercostal space risks pneumothorax.胸骨下段先天性胸骨孔并不少见（尸检与 CT 研究报道约 4%–13%），体表摸不出：直刺可穿孔直达心包与心脏，曾有心脏压塞致死报道。只沿皮下平刺；偏外进入肋间有气胸风险。

CV18 YùtángCV18 玉堂

Where is CV18 Yùtáng?玉堂（CV18）在哪里？

On the chest, level with the 3rd intercostal space, on the anterior midline.胸部，横平第 3 肋间隙，前正中线上。

How is CV18 needled?玉堂（CV18）怎么刺？

Transverse; 0.3–0.5 cun.平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at CV18?玉堂（CV18）最要注意的安全问题？

Behind the sternum lie the pericardium and mediastinum, and laterally the intercostal space and pleura (pneumothorax): transverse subcutaneous needling only.胸骨后为心包与纵隔，偏外即肋间与胸膜（气胸）：只沿皮下平刺，不直刺、不偏外。

CV19 ZǐgōngCV19 紫宫

Where is CV19 Zǐgōng?紫宫（CV19）在哪里？

On the chest, level with the 2nd intercostal space, on the anterior midline.胸部，横平第 2 肋间隙，前正中线上。

How is CV19 needled?紫宫（CV19）怎么刺？

Transverse; 0.3–0.5 cun.平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at CV19?紫宫（CV19）最要注意的安全问题？

Behind the sternum lie the great vessels, and laterally the intercostal space and pleura (pneumothorax): transverse only, never perpendicular.胸骨后为纵隔大血管，偏外即肋间与胸膜（气胸）：只平刺，不直刺。

CV20 HuágàiCV20 华盖

Where is CV20 Huágài?华盖（CV20）在哪里？

On the chest, level with the 1st intercostal space, on the anterior midline.胸部，横平第 1 肋间隙，前正中线上。

How is CV20 needled?华盖（CV20）怎么刺？

Transverse; 0.3–0.5 cun.平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at CV20?华盖（CV20）最要注意的安全问题？

Behind the manubrium lie the left brachiocephalic vein and aortic arch, and laterally the 1st space and pleural dome (pneumothorax): transverse only.胸骨柄后为左头臂静脉与主动脉弓，偏外为第 1 肋间与胸膜顶（气胸）：只平刺。

CV21 XuánjīCV21 璇玑

Where is CV21 Xuánjī?璇玑（CV21）在哪里？

On the chest, 1 cun below the suprasternal fossa, on the anterior midline.胸部，胸骨上窝下 1 寸，前正中线上。

How is CV21 needled?璇玑（CV21）怎么刺？

Transverse; 0.3–0.5 cun.平刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Main safety point at CV21?璇玑（CV21）最要注意的安全问题？

Behind the manubrium lie the brachiocephalic trunk and left brachiocephalic vein, with the pleural dome laterally (pneumothorax): transverse only.胸骨柄后为头臂干与左头臂静脉，偏外近胸膜顶（气胸）：只平刺。

CV22 TiāntūCV22 天突

Where is CV22 Tiāntū?天突（CV22）在哪里？

In the anterior neck, at the centre of the suprasternal fossa, on the anterior midline.颈前区，胸骨上窝中央，前正中线上。

How is CV22 needled?天突（CV22）怎么刺？

First perpendicular 0.2–0.3 cun, then turn the tip downward and advance slowly close behind the manubrium; 0.5–1 cun.先直刺 0.2–0.3 寸，再将针尖转向下方，紧靠胸骨柄后缘缓慢刺入；0.5–1 寸。

Special-point roles of CV22?天突（CV22）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Conception and Yin Linking vessels任脉、阴维脉交会穴

Main safety point at CV22?天突（CV22）最要注意的安全问题？

The trachea lies behind, the aortic arch, brachiocephalic trunk and left brachiocephalic vein lie behind and below the manubrium, and the common carotids and pleural domes lie laterally (pneumothorax): go in 0.2 cun perpendicular, then down along the back of the manubrium; withdraw on elastic resistance, coughing, or a needle that pulses.后方是气管，胸骨柄后下方是主动脉弓、头臂干与左头臂静脉，两侧有颈总动脉与胸膜顶（气胸）：先直刺 0.2 寸再贴胸骨柄后缘向下，针下有弹性阻力或患者呛咳、针体随搏动即退针。

CV23 LiánquánCV23 廉泉

Where is CV23 Liánquán?廉泉（CV23）在哪里？

In the anterior neck, above the laryngeal prominence, in the depression above the hyoid bone, on the anterior midline.颈前区，喉结上方，舌骨上缘凹陷中，前正中线上。

How is CV23 needled?廉泉（CV23）怎么刺？

Oblique toward the root of the tongue; 0.5–0.8 cun.向舌根方向斜刺；0.5–0.8 寸。

Special-point roles of CV23?廉泉（CV23）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Conception and Yin Linking vessels任脉、阴维脉交会穴

Main safety point at CV23?廉泉（CV23）最要注意的安全问题？

Angle only along the midline toward the tongue root: laterally and deep lie the submandibular gland, lingual artery and carotid sheath; never enter the larynx or airway. Sudden aphasia or dysphagia needs stroke assessment first.针只在正中向舌根斜刺：偏外深部有颌下腺、舌动脉与颈动脉鞘；不刺入喉部与气道。突发失语、吞咽困难先按卒中急症就医。

CV24 ChéngjiāngCV24 承浆

Where is CV24 Chéngjiāng?承浆（CV24）在哪里？

On the face, in the depression at the centre of the mentolabial groove.面部，颏唇沟的正中凹陷处。

How is CV24 needled?承浆（CV24）怎么刺？

Oblique; 0.3–0.5 cun.斜刺；0.3–0.5 寸。

Special-point roles of CV24?承浆（CV24）是哪类特定穴？

Crossing point of the Conception Vessel and Foot-Yangming channel任脉、足阳明交会穴

Main safety point at CV24?承浆（CV24）最要注意的安全问题？

The mandible lies just beneath, so needle shallow and oblique; laterally lie the mental foramen and nerve.针下即下颌骨，只浅斜刺；偏外近颏孔与颏神经。
